EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss.doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).
EquitySecuritiesFvNiGainLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)

EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss.doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).
EquitySecuritiesFvNiRealizedGainLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)

EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGainLoss.doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).
EquitySecuritiesFvNiUnrealizedGainLoss.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)

EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDeterminab.doc: Amount of impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.
EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDeterminab.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Annual Amount

EquitySecuritiesWithoutReadilyDeterminab.doc: Amount of gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

ExciseAndSalesTaxes.doc: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.
ExciseAndSalesTaxes.label: Excise and Sales Taxes

ExciseTaxesCollected.doc: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingA.doc: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.
ExpenseRelatedToDistributionOrServicingA.label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees

ExplorationExpense.doc: "Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or ""G&G"" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells."
ExplorationExpense.label: Exploration Expense

FIFOInventoryAmount.doc: The amount of FIFO (first in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.
FIFOInventoryAmount.label: FIFO Inventory Amount

FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants.doc: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.
FairValueAdjustmentOfWarrants.label: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants

FairValueNetAssetLiability.doc: Fair value of asset after deduction of liability.
FairValueNetAssetLiability.label: Fair Value, Net Asset (Liability)

FairValueOfAssetsAcquired.doc: The fair value of assets acquired in noncash investing or financing activities.
FairValueOfAssetsAcquired.label: Fair Value of Assets Acquired

FairValueOptionChangesInFairValueGainLos.doc: For each line item in the statement of financial position, the amounts of gains and losses from fair value changes included in earnings.
FairValueOptionChangesInFairValueGainLos.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)

FederalDepositInsuranceCorporationPremiu.doc: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.
FederalDepositInsuranceCorporationPremiu.label: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense

FederalFundsPurchased.doc: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.
FederalFundsPurchased.label: Federal Funds Purchased

FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesLoaned.doc: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.doc: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.
FederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUn.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase

FederalFundsSold.doc: The amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements.
FederalFundsSold.label: Federal Funds Sold

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesBorrowedOrP.doc: Fair value portion of federal funds sold and securities borrowed or purchased under agreements to resell.
FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesBorrowedOrP.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Fair Value Disclosure

FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.doc: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).
FederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUn.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.doc: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesBranchOfFHLBB.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Branch of FHLBank, Amount

FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLongTerm.doc: Including both current and noncurrent portions, Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.
FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesLongTerm.label: Long-Term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances

FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of consolidated obligation bonds and discount notes issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations

FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of bonds issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations, Bonds

FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.doc: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of discount notes issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
FederalHomeLoanBankConsolidatedObligatio.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations, Discount Notes

FederalHomeLoanBankStock.doc: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).
FederalHomeLoanBankStock.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock

FederalHomeLoanBankStockAndFederalReserv.doc: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) and Federal Reserve Bank stock.
FederalHomeLoanBankStockAndFederalReserv.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock and Federal Reserve Bank Stock

FeeIncome.doc: Amount of fee income including, but not limited to, managerial assistance, servicing of investment, and origination and commitment fees.
FeeIncome.label: Fee Income

FeesAndCommissionsMortgageBankingAndServ.doc: Income from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions) and servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others net of any related impairment of capitalized service costs. Also includes any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans.
FeesAndCommissionsMortgageBankingAndServ.label: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking and Servicing

FinanceLeaseInterestExpense.doc: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.
FinanceLeaseInterestExpense.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense

FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLiability.doc: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.
FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLiability.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability

FinanceLeaseLiability.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.
FinanceLeaseLiability.label: Finance Lease, Liability

FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.
FinanceLeaseLiabilityCurrent.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current

FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.
FinanceLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent

FinanceLeasePrincipalPayments.doc: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.
FinanceLeasePrincipalPayments.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments

FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset.doc: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.
FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAsset.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization

FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortization.doc: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.
FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortization.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization

FinanceLeaseRightOfUseAssetBeforeAccumul.doc: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAtFairValue.doc: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedAtFairValue.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortga.doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card receivables), either fixed or revolving, that by their terms convert into cash within a finite time period. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedMortgagesMortga.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-Backed and Asset-Backed Securities, at Fair Value

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedOtherAtFairValu.doc: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

FinancialInstrumentsOwnedUSGovernmentAnd.doc: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.
FinancialInstrumentsOwnedUSGovernmentAnd.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value

FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedA.doc: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.
FinancialInstrumentsSoldNotYetPurchasedA.label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value

FinancingInterestExpense.doc: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.
FinancingInterestExpense.label: Financing Interest Expense

FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestAfterA.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.
FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestAfterA.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss

FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestBefore.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.
FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestBefore.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Excluding Accrued Interest, Current

FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLos.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss

FinancingReceivableDeferredIncome.doc: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss

FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.doc: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.
Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInter.label: Financing Receivable, Excluding Accrued Interest, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)

FinancingReceivableLoanInProcess.doc: Amount of undisbursed portion of financing receivable balance. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.
FinancingReceivableLoanInProcess.label: Financing Receivable, Loan in Process

FinancingReceivableReclassificationToHel.doc: Amount of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale.
FinancingReceivableReclassificationToHel.label: Financing Receivable, Reclassification to Held-for-Sale

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAm.doc: Accumulated amount of amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsAccumulatedAm.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization

FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.doc: Amount after amortization of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life.
FiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsNet.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net

FlightEquipmentGross.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.
FlightEquipmentGross.label: Flight Equipment, Gross

FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearanceFees.doc: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.
FloorBrokerageExchangeAndClearanceFees.label: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBefore.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBefore.label: Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.doc: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealiz.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.doc: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, before Tax

ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.doc: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.
ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnreal.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax

FuelCosts.doc: Fuel costs incurred that are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.
FuelCosts.label: Fuel Costs

FundsHeldForClients.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.
FundsHeldForClients.label: Funds Held for Clients

FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsAsset.doc: Amount of the reinsurer's funds held on its behalf by the ceding insurer, including funds held in trust, under reinsurance treaties or contracts with the assuming insurer as security for the payment of the obligations thereunder.
FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsAsset.label: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset

FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsLiabi.doc: Amount of funds held as security for payments to be received under reinsurance contracts.
FundsHeldUnderReinsuranceAgreementsLiabi.label: Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability

GainLossFromComponentsExcludedFromAssess.doc: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

GainLossOnContractTermination.doc: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.
GainLossOnContractTermination.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination

GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.doc: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.
GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax

GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.
GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property

GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.
GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets

GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrume.doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.
GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrume.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments

GainLossOnInvestments.doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.
GainLossOnInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments

GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness.doc: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.
GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business

GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives.doc: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.
GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives

GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments.doc: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.
GainLossOnSaleOfInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments

GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperating.doc: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.
GainLossOnSaleOfLeasedAssetsNetOperating.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases

GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
GainLossOnSaleOfLoansAndLeases.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases

GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.doc: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
GainLossOnSaleOfMortgageLoans.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans

GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.
GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets

GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.doc: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.
GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments

GainLossOnSaleOfProperties.doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
GainLossOnSaleOfProperties.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties

GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.
GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment

GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.doc: Gain (loss) related to the sale of trust assets (includes, but is not limited to, gold and silver) to pay trust expenses.
GainLossOnSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpenses.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses

GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmen.doc: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.
GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmen.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges

GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.
GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net

GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritie.doc: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).
GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritie.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS)

GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.doc: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.
GainLossOnSecuritizationOfFinancialAsset.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets

GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.
GainLossOnTerminationOfLease.label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease

GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement.doc: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.
GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement.label: Gain (Loss) from Litigation Settlement

GainOnSaleOfInvestments.doc: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.
GainOnSaleOfInvestments.label: Gain on Sale of Investments

GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt.doc: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.
GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebt.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt

GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebtBeforeW.doc: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.
GainsLossesOnExtinguishmentOfDebtBeforeW.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Debt Issuance Cost Writeoff

GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.
GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations

GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate.doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.
GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate

GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate.doc: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.
GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate

GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.doc: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.
GeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.label: General and Administrative Expense

GeneralInsuranceExpense.doc: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).
GeneralInsuranceExpense.label: General Insurance Expense

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccount.doc: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.
GeneralPartnersCapitalAccount.label: General Partners' Capital Account

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsIssued.doc: The number of general partner units issued.
GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsIssued.label: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued

GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.doc: The number of general partner units outstanding.
GeneralPartnersCapitalAccountUnitsOutsta.label: General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding

GoodFaithAndMarginDepositsWithBrokerDeal.doc: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).
GoodFaithAndMarginDepositsWithBrokerDeal.label: Good Faith and Margin Deposit with Broker-Dealer

Goodwill.doc: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.
Goodwill.label: Goodwill

GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpairment.doc: Total loss recognized during the period from the impairment of goodwill plus the loss recognized in the period resulting from the impairment of the carrying amount of intangible assets, other than goodwill.
GoodwillAndIntangibleAssetImpairment.label: Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment

GoodwillImpairmentLoss.doc: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.
GoodwillImpairmentLoss.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss

GrossInvestmentIncomeOperating.doc: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.
GrossInvestmentIncomeOperating.label: Gross Investment Income, Operating

GrossProfit.doc: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.
GrossProfit.label: Gross Profit

GuaranteedInterestContracts.doc: The amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date pertaining to the guarantee given by the insurance entity to contract holders of a specified rate of return (a guaranteed yield) on their investments for a specified period.

HeldToMaturitySecurities.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
HeldToMaturitySecurities.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesCurrent.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesFairValue.doc: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesFairValue.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value

HeldToMaturitySecuritiesRestricted.doc: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
HeldToMaturitySecuritiesRestricted.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Restricted

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoo.doc: The amount of impairment loss recognized in the period resulting from the write-down of the carrying amount of an intangible asset (excluding goodwill) to fair value.
ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoo.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)

ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefiniteli.doc: Amount of impairment loss resulting from write-down of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance and having a projected indefinite period of benefit to fair value.
ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsIndefiniteli.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets, Indefinite-Lived (Excluding Goodwill)

ImpairmentOfLeasehold.doc: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.
ImpairmentOfLeasehold.label: Impairment of Leasehold

ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse.doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long lived assets held for use (including those held for disposal by means other than sale).
ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse.label: Impairment, Long-Lived Asset, Held-for-Use

ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedO.doc: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.
ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedO.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of

ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties.doc: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities.
ImpairmentOfOilAndGasProperties.label: Impairment, Oil and Gas, Property with Unproved and Proved Reserves

ImpairmentOfOngoingProject.doc: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.
ImpairmentOfOngoingProject.label: Impairment of Ongoing Project

ImpairmentOfRealEstate.doc: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.
ImpairmentOfRealEstate.label: Impairment of Real Estate

IncentiveFeeExpense.doc: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.
IncentiveFeeExpense.label: Incentive Fee Expense

IncentiveFeeExpenseCapitalGainBased.doc: Amount of expense for capital-gain-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncentiveFeeExpenseCapitalGainBased.label: Incentive Fee Expense, Capital-Gain-Based

IncentiveFeeExpenseIncomeBased.doc: Amount of expense for income-based incentive fee for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncentiveFeeExpenseIncomeBased.label: Incentive Fee Expense, Income-Based

IncentiveFeePayableCapitalGainBased.doc: Amount of capital-gain-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncentiveFeePayableCapitalGainBased.label: Incentive Fee Payable, Capital-Gain-Based

IncentiveFeePayableIncomeBased.doc: Amount of income-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncentiveFeePayableIncomeBased.label: Incentive Fee Payable, Income-Based

IncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingIn.doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.
IncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingIn.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax

IncomeLossAttributableToParent.doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.
IncomeLossAttributableToParent.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax

IncomeLossFromAffordableHousingProjectsE.doc: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAttrib.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAttrib.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.doc: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.doc: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBefore.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsInclud.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsInclud.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBas.doc: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerBas.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share

IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDil.doc: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.
IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsPerDil.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.doc: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share

IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.doc: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.
IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetO.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share

IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments.doc: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).
IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments

IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNet.doc: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.
IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestmentsNet.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions

IncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributableTo.doc: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.
IncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributableTo.label: Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax

IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.doc: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.
IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)

IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.
IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived.label: Income Tax Paid, Federal, after Refund Received

IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundRec.doc: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.
IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundRec.label: Income Tax Paid, State and Local, after Refund Received

IncomeTaxReceivable.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.
IncomeTaxReceivable.label: Income Taxes Receivable

IncomeTaxesPaid.doc: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.
IncomeTaxesPaid.label: Income Taxes Paid

IncomeTaxesPaidNet.doc: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.
IncomeTaxesPaidNet.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net

IncomeTaxesReceivable.doc: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.
IncomeTaxesReceivable.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current

IncomeTaxesReceivableNoncurrent.doc: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.
IncomeTaxesReceivableNoncurrent.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent

IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFromCounte.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.
IncreaseDecreaseCashCollateralFromCounte.label: Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties

IncreaseDecreaseDueFromAffiliates.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
IncreaseDecreaseDueFromAffiliates.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndNotesReceiv.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndNotesReceiv.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceiv.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsAndOtherReceiv.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccr.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccr.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndOthe.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndOthe.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableRelated.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for goods and services provided by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries, subsidiaries of a common parent, an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableRelated.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Related Parties

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableTrade.doc: Change in recurring obligations of a business that arise from the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services used in the production and sale of goods and services.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableTrade.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Trade

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableAndO.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableAndO.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets

IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableRela.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due to the reporting entity for good and services provided to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsReceivableRela.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable, Related Parties

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPaya.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedIncomeTaxesPaya.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceiva.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from borrowers for interest payments.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInterestReceiva.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Interest Receivable, Net

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInvestmentIncom.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedInvestmentIncom.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndO.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndO.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedSalaries.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedSalaries.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries

IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayable.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.
IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedTaxesPayable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable

IncreaseDecreaseInAllowanceForEquityFund.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the capitalized cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and / or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments. As a result of this capitalization, net income is increased. This element pertains to certain regulated industries, such as public utilities.
IncreaseDecreaseInAllowanceForEquityFund.label: Increase (Decrease) in Allowance for Equity Funds Used During Construction

IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligat.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.
IncreaseDecreaseInAssetRetirementObligat.label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations

IncreaseDecreaseInAssetsHeldForSale.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).
IncreaseDecreaseInAssetsHeldForSale.label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset, Held-for-Sale

IncreaseDecreaseInBookOverdrafts.doc: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerDealerRelatedRec.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.
IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerDealerRelatedRec.label: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net

IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerageReceivables.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.
IncreaseDecreaseInBrokerageReceivables.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization

IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateralForBorro.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is pledged as security when borrowing securities.

IncreaseDecreaseInCashCollateralForLoane.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

IncreaseDecreaseInCollateralHeldUnderSec.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of assets, which may include but are not limited to cash and investments, received as collateral pertaining to securities loaned to a counterparty to the transaction. Includes the change during the period in any unrealized gain or loss on such investments.
IncreaseDecreaseInCollateralHeldUnderSec.label: Increase (Decrease) in Collateral Held under Securities Lending

IncreaseDecreaseInCommodityContractAsset.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.
IncreaseDecreaseInCommodityContractAsset.label: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerAs.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.
IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerAs.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Asset

IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerLi.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.
IncreaseDecreaseInContractWithCustomerLi.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability

IncreaseDecreaseInDebtSecuritiesTrading.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).
IncreaseDecreaseInDebtSecuritiesTrading.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredCharges.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredCharges.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredFuelCosts.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredFuelCosts.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLiabilities.doc: Change during the period in carrying value for all deferred liabilities due within one year or operating cycle.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredLiabilities.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisit.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredPolicyAcquisit.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs

IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredRevenue.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue

IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.
IncreaseDecreaseInDemandDeposits.label: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits

IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssets.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.
IncreaseDecreaseInDepositOtherAssets.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets

IncreaseDecreaseInDeposits.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.
IncreaseDecreaseInDeposits.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits

IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsWithOtherFeder.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
IncreaseDecreaseInDepositsWithOtherFeder.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks

IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssets.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).
IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssets.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets

IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssetsAndLia.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).
IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeAssetsAndLia.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeLiabilities.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).
IncreaseDecreaseInDerivativeLiabilities.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInDividendsReceivable.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.
IncreaseDecreaseInDividendsReceivable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Dividends Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromAffiliatesCurre.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromAffiliatesCurre.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current

IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedPartiesC.doc: The aggregate increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.
IncreaseDecreaseInDueFromRelatedPartiesC.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current

IncreaseDecreaseInDueToAffiliates.doc: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
IncreaseDecreaseInDueToAffiliates.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates

IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedParties.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.
IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedParties.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties

IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesCur.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.
IncreaseDecreaseInDueToRelatedPartiesCur.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties, Current

IncreaseDecreaseInEmployeeRelatedLiabili.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.
IncreaseDecreaseInEmployeeRelatedLiabili.label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInEquitySecuritiesFvNi.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).
IncreaseDecreaseInEquitySecuritiesFvNi.label: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI

IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueAdjustmentsOn.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
IncreaseDecreaseInFairValueAdjustmentsOn.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchased.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.
IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchased.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedA.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.
IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedA.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net

IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSold.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.
IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSold.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Sold

IncreaseDecreaseInFilmCosts1.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film. Examples include, but are not limited to, costs of story and scenario, compensation, set construction and postproduction costs.

IncreaseDecreaseInFinanceReceivables.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.
IncreaseDecreaseInFinanceReceivables.label: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables

IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsSo.doc: "The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased. Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the broker-dealer for trading or investment purposes are included in ""Securities Owned and Securities Sold, Not Yet Purchased."" Although proprietary trading is frequently thought of as purchasing securities for sale to others, trading securities for the broker-dealer's own account sometimes leads to a liability for the fair value of securities sold but not yet purchased, that is, sold short. The broker-dealer is then obliged to purchase the securities at a future date at the then-current market price."

IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsUs.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.
IncreaseDecreaseInFinancialInstrumentsUs.label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities

IncreaseDecreaseInFossilFuelInventories.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fossil fuel held in inventory.

IncreaseDecreaseInFuelInventories.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.
IncreaseDecreaseInFuelInventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories

IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsura.doc: The change in funds held under reinsurance agreements or treaty (contract between the reinsurer and the ceding entity stipulating the manner in which insurance written on various risks is to be shared).
IncreaseDecreaseInFundsHeldUnderReinsura.label: Increase (Decrease) in Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements

IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitRes.doc: The change in the future policy benefit reserve balance on the balance sheet.
IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitRes.label: Increase (Decrease) in Future Policy Benefit Reserves

IncreaseDecreaseInFuturePolicyBenefitRes.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in estimated future policy benefit obligations under insurance contracts, and obligations under insurance contracts classified as other.

IncreaseDecreaseInGasImbalanceReceivable.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivable in gas-balancing arrangement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

IncreaseDecreaseInHealthCareInsuranceLia.doc: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.
IncreaseDecreaseInHealthCareInsuranceLia.label: Increase (Decrease) in Health Care Insurance Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayableInc.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in income-based incentive fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncreaseDecreaseInIncentiveFeePayableInc.label: Increase (Decrease) in Incentive Fee Payable, Income-Based

IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxes.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.
IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxes.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes

IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesPayableNetO.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.
IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesPayableNetO.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesReceivable.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.
IncreaseDecreaseInIncomeTaxesReceivable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceLiabilities.doc: The increase (decrease) in insurance liability balances during the period.
IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceLiabilities.label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities

IncreaseDecreaseInInsuranceSettlementsRe.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsRe.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.
IncreaseDecreaseInInterestAndDividendsRe.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable

IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.
IncreaseDecreaseInInterestPayableNet.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net

IncreaseDecreaseInInventories.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of all inventory held by the reporting entity, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.
IncreaseDecreaseInInventories.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories

IncreaseDecreaseInInventoriesAndOtherOpe.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.
IncreaseDecreaseInInventoriesAndOtherOpe.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets

IncreaseDecreaseInLeasingReceivables.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from lessees arising from lease agreements.
IncreaseDecreaseInLeasingReceivables.label: Increase (Decrease) in Leasing Receivables

IncreaseDecreaseInLiabilityForClaimsAndC.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.
IncreaseDecreaseInLiabilityForClaimsAndC.label: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalH.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).
IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalH.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSale.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.
IncreaseDecreaseInLoansHeldForSale.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loan, Held-for-Sale

IncreaseDecreaseInLoansToFederalHomeLoan.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.
IncreaseDecreaseInLoansToFederalHomeLoan.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks

IncreaseDecreaseInLongTermReceivablesCur.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).
IncreaseDecreaseInLongTermReceivablesCur.label: Increase (Decrease) in Long-Term Receivables, Current

IncreaseDecreaseInManagementAndIncentive.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) management and incentive fees payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncreaseDecreaseInManagementAndIncentive.label: Increase (Decrease) in Management and Incentive Fees Payable

IncreaseDecreaseInManagementFeePayable.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) management fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
IncreaseDecreaseInManagementFeePayable.label: Increase (Decrease) in Management Fee Payable

IncreaseDecreaseInMarginDepositsOutstand.doc: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in money or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivative position.
IncreaseDecreaseInMarginDepositsOutstand.label: Increase (Decrease) in Margin Deposits Outstanding

IncreaseDecreaseInMarketableSecuritiesRe.doc: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in total debt and equity financial instruments including: (1) securities held-to-maturity, (2) trading securities, and (3) securities available-for-sale that are pledged to one or more secured parties who have the right to buy, sell, or re-pledge the collateral.

IncreaseDecreaseInMaterialsAndSupplies.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.
IncreaseDecreaseInMaterialsAndSupplies.label: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
