Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

LoansPayable.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).
LoansPayable.label: Loans Payable

LoansPayableCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.
LoansPayableCurrent.label: Loans Payable, Current

LoansPayableToBankCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.
LoansPayableToBankCurrent.label: Loans Payable to Bank, Current

LoansReceivableFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of loan receivable, including, but not limited to, mortgage loans held for investment, finance receivables held for investment, policy loans on insurance contracts.
LoansReceivableFairValueDisclosure.label: Loans Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleAmount.doc: Amount, before valuation allowance, of financing receivable classified as held-for-sale.
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleAmount.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfDi.doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.
LoansReceivableHeldForSaleNetNotPartOfDi.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance

LoansReceivableHeldForSaleReconciliation.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

LongTermAccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableN.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.
LongTermAccountsNotesAndLoansReceivableN.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent

LongTermDebt.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.
LongTermDebt.label: Long-Term Debt

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCu.doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsCu.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current

LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsIn.doc: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.
LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligationsIn.label: Long-Term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities

LongTermDebtCurrent.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.
LongTermDebtCurrent.label: Long-Term Debt, Current Maturities

LongTermDebtFairValue.doc: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.
LongTermDebtFairValue.label: Long-Term Debt, Fair Value

LongTermDebtNoncurrent.doc: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.
LongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Long-Term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities

LongTermInvestments.doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).
LongTermInvestments.label: Long-Term Investments

LongTermInvestmentsAndReceivablesNet.doc: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.
LongTermInvestmentsAndReceivablesNet.label: Long-Term Investments and Receivables, Net

LongTermLineOfCredit.doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.
LongTermLineOfCredit.label: Long-Term Line of Credit, Noncurrent

LongTermLoansPayable.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.
LongTermLoansPayable.label: Loans Payable, Noncurrent

LongTermNotesAndLoans.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.
LongTermNotesAndLoans.label: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent

LongTermNotesPayable.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.
LongTermNotesPayable.label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent

LongTermTransitionBond.doc: Long-Term transition bonds are bonds under the Competition Act in which the proceeds of Transition Bonds are required to be used principally to reduce qualified stranded costs and the related capitalization of the utility. This represents the noncurrent portion.
LongTermTransitionBond.label: Long-Term Transition Bond, Noncurrent

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueCurre.doc: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueCurre.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Current

LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueNoncu.doc: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
LossContingencyAccrualCarryingValueNoncu.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Noncurrent

LossContingencyLossInPeriod.doc: The amount of loss pertaining to the specified contingency that was charged against earnings in the period, including the effects of revisions in previously reported estimates.
LossContingencyLossInPeriod.label: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period

MachineryAndEquipmentGross.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.
MachineryAndEquipmentGross.label: Machinery and Equipment, Gross

ManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayable.doc: Amount of management and incentive fees payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.
ManagementAndIncentiveFeesPayable.label: Management and Incentive Fees Payable

ManagementFeeExpense.doc: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.
ManagementFeeExpense.label: Management Fee Expense

ManagementFeePayable.doc: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.
ManagementFeePayable.label: Management Fee Payable

MarginDepositAssets.doc: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.
MarginDepositAssets.label: Margin Deposit Assets

MarketRiskBenefitAssetAmount.doc: Amount of asset position for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

MarketRiskBenefitChangeInFairValueGainLo.doc: Amount of gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in fair value of contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk. Excludes change attributable to instrument-specific credit risk.

MarketRiskBenefitLiabilityAmount.doc: Amount of liability position for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

MarketRiskBenefitNetAmountAtRisk.doc: Amount of guaranteed benefit in excess of current account balance of contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

MarketRiskBenefitReinsuranceRecoverableA.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, recoverable under reinsurance for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

MarketableSecurities.doc: Amount of investment in marketable security.
MarketableSecurities.label: Marketable Securities

MarketableSecuritiesCurrent.doc: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.
MarketableSecuritiesCurrent.label: Marketable Securities, Current

MarketableSecuritiesGainLoss.doc: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).
MarketableSecuritiesGainLoss.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)

MarketableSecuritiesNoncurrent.doc: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as noncurrent.
MarketableSecuritiesNoncurrent.label: Marketable Securities, Noncurrent

MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLossExcl.doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.
MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLossExcl.label: Marketable Security, Realized Gain (Loss)

MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss.doc: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.
MarketableSecuritiesUnrealizedGainLoss.label: Marketable Security, Unrealized Gain (Loss)

MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.doc: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.
MarketingAndAdvertisingExpense.label: Marketing and Advertising Expense

MarketingExpense.doc: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.
MarketingExpense.label: Marketing Expense

MaterialsSuppliesAndOther.doc: The carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, and other assets, which are not included in inventory but used in production.
MaterialsSuppliesAndOther.label: Materials, Supplies, and Other

MaturitiesOfSeniorDebt.doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.
MaturitiesOfSeniorDebt.label: Maturities of Senior Debt

MaturitiesOfSubordinatedDebt.doc: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

MembersCapital.doc: Amount of member capital in limited liability company (LLC).
MembersCapital.label: Members' Capital

MembersEquity.doc: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.
MembersEquity.label: Members' Equity

MembersEquityAttributableToNoncontrollin.doc: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.
MembersEquityAttributableToNoncontrollin.label: Members' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

MinorityInterest.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.
MinorityInterest.label: Equity, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPrefe.doc: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.
MinorityInterestAmountRepresentedByPrefe.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock

MinorityInterestChangeInRedemptionValue.doc: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.
MinorityInterestChangeInRedemptionValue.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value

MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDistribution.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.
MinorityInterestDecreaseFromDistribution.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders

MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.doc: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).
MinorityInterestDecreaseFromRedemptions.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests

MinorityInterestInJointVentures.doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in joint ventures included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.
MinorityInterestInJointVentures.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Joint Ventures

MinorityInterestInOperatingPartnerships.doc: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners in an operating partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.
MinorityInterestInOperatingPartnerships.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Operating Partnerships

MinorityInterestPeriodIncreaseDecrease.doc: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.
MinorityInterestPeriodIncreaseDecrease.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)

MoneyMarketFundsAtCarryingValue.doc: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.
MoneyMarketFundsAtCarryingValue.label: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value

MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndCo.doc: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.
MortgageLoansOnRealEstateCommercialAndCo.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net

MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpairmentReco.doc: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.
MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpairmentReco.label: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)

MortgagesHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of mortgage loans held-for-sale.
MortgagesHeldForSaleFairValueDisclosure.label: Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale, Fair Value Disclosure

NetAssetValuePerShare.doc: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.
NetAssetValuePerShare.label: Net Asset Value Per Share

NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOpera.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInDiscontinuedOpera.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to continuing operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activity, Continuing Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activity, Continuing Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Including Discontinued Operation

NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.
NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActiviti.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Continuing Operation

NetChangeAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertifica.doc: The cash inflow or outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.

NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsDomestic.doc: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.
NetChangeInterestBearingDepositsDomestic.label: Net Change Interest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic

NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsDomes.doc: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.
NetChangeNoninterestBearingDepositsDomes.label: Net Change Noninterest-Bearing Deposits, Domestic

NetIncomeLoss.doc: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.
NetIncomeLoss.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent

NetIncomeLossAllocatedToGeneralPartners.doc: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to general partners.
NetIncomeLossAllocatedToGeneralPartners.label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to General Partners

NetIncomeLossAllocatedToLimitedPartners.doc: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to limited partners.
NetIncomeLossAllocatedToLimitedPartners.label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to Limited Partners

NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollin.doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.
NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollin.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemable.doc: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.
NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemable.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest

NetIncomeLossAttributableToParentNetOfFe.doc: Amount of profit (loss) after Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments attributable to the parent.
NetIncomeLossAttributableToParentNetOfFe.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Net of Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments

NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedeemableNon.doc: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.
NetIncomeLossAttributableToRedeemableNon.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic

NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.
NetIncomeLossAvailableToCommonStockholde.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted

NetIncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAva.doc: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.
NetIncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsAva.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic

NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributabl.doc: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.
NetIncomeLossIncludingPortionAttributabl.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest

NetIncomeLossNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimit.doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.
NetIncomeLossNetOfTaxPerOutstandingLimit.label: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted

NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.doc: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.
NetIncomeLossPerOutstandingLimitedPartne.label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax

NetInvestmentInLease.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.
NetInvestmentInLease.label: Net Investment in Lease, before Allowance for Credit Loss

NetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCre.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLo.doc: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInte.doc: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

NetInvestmentIncome.doc: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.
NetInvestmentIncome.label: Net Investment Income

NetPeriodicDefinedBenefitsExpenseReversa.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.
NetPeriodicDefinedBenefitsExpenseReversa.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component

NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.doc: Net number of shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.
NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.label: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Shares

NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.doc: Value of net shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.
NetSharesReclassifiedToMandatorilyRedeem.label: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Value

NonInvestmentAssetsLessNonInvestmentLiab.doc: Amount of noninvestment asset (liability) representing difference between aggregate value of investments, including, but not limited to, long and short positions, and net assets.
NonInvestmentAssetsLessNonInvestmentLiab.label: Noninvestment Assets Less Noninvestment Liabilities

NonInvestmentAssetsLessNonInvestmentLiab.doc: Percentage of noninvestment asset and liability, including, but not limited to, long and short positions, to net assets.
NonInvestmentAssetsLessNonInvestmentLiab.label: Noninvestment Asset Less Noninvestment Liability, Percent of Net Asset

NoncashContributionExpense.doc: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.
NoncashContributionExpense.label: Noncash Contribution Expense

NoncashMergerRelatedCosts.doc: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.
NoncashMergerRelatedCosts.label: Noncash Merger Related Costs

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionDebtAssum.doc: "The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionDebtAssum.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionIntangibl.doc: "The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionIntangibl.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionInvestmen.doc: "The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionInvestmen.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionNetNonmon.doc: "The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionNetNonmon.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionPayablesA.doc: "The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionPayablesA.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAs.doc: "The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAs.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired

NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfLi.doc: "The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfLi.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed

NoncashOrPartNoncashDivestitureAmountOfC.doc: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.
NoncashOrPartNoncashDivestitureAmountOfC.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received

NoncontrollingInterestDecreaseFromDecons.doc: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.
NoncontrollingInterestDecreaseFromDecons.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation

NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossJoi.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.
NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossJoi.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Redeemable

NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOpe.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling partner in an operating partnership.
NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOpe.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Operating Partnerships, Redeemable

NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossPre.doc: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

NoncontrollingInterestInVariableInterest.doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).
NoncontrollingInterestInVariableInterest.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity

NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromBusine.doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.
NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromBusine.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination

NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSaleOf.doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.
NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSaleOf.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest

NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSubsid.doc: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.
NoncontrollingInterestIncreaseFromSubsid.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance

NonfinancialLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosu.doc: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilities.doc: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.
NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilities.label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDome.doc: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.
NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesDome.label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic

NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesFore.doc: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.
NoninterestBearingDepositLiabilitiesFore.label: Noninterest-Bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign

NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDemand.doc: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.
NoninterestBearingDomesticDepositDemand.label: Noninterest-Bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand

NoninterestExpense.doc: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.
NoninterestExpense.label: Noninterest Expense

NoninterestExpenseCommissionExpense.doc: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvisoryFees.doc: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.
NoninterestExpenseInvestmentAdvisoryFees.label: Investment Advisory Fee

NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentAndCustod.doc: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.
NoninterestExpenseTransferAgentAndCustod.label: Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees

NoninterestIncome.doc: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.
NoninterestIncome.label: Noninterest Income

NoninterestIncomeOther.doc: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.
NoninterestIncomeOther.label: Noninterest Income, Other

NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingIncome.doc: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.
NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingIncome.label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income

NonoperatingGainsLosses.doc: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).
NonoperatingGainsLosses.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)

NonoperatingIncomeExpense.doc: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).
NonoperatingIncomeExpense.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)

NonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest.doc: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.
NonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest.label: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest

NontradeReceivablesCurrent.doc: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
NontradeReceivablesCurrent.label: Nontrade Receivables, Current

NontradeReceivablesNoncurrent.doc: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
NontradeReceivablesNoncurrent.label: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent

NotesAndLoansPayable.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).
NotesAndLoansPayable.label: Notes and Loans Payable

NotesAndLoansReceivableGrossNoncurrent.doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

NotesAndLoansReceivableNetCurrent.doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.
NotesAndLoansReceivableNetCurrent.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current

NotesAndLoansReceivableNetNoncurrent.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.
NotesAndLoansReceivableNetNoncurrent.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent

NotesPayable.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
NotesPayable.label: Notes Payable

NotesPayableCurrent.doc: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.
NotesPayableCurrent.label: Notes Payable, Current

NotesPayableToBankCurrent.doc: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.
NotesPayableToBankCurrent.label: Notes Payable to Bank, Current

NotesReceivableFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the holder a definite sum of money at a future date.

NotesReceivableGross.doc: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.
NotesReceivableGross.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss

NotesReceivableNet.doc: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.
NotesReceivableNet.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss

NuclearFuelNetOfAmortization.doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.
NuclearFuelNetOfAmortization.label: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization

ObligationToReturnSecuritiesReceivedAsCo.doc: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.
ObligationToReturnSecuritiesReceivedAsCo.label: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral

OccupancyNet.doc: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.
OccupancyNet.label: Occupancy, Net

OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.doc: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), after Tax

OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.doc: Amount, before tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), before Tax

OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).
OciDebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransfe.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), Tax

OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTax.doc: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.
OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTax.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax

OciEquityMethodInvestmentBeforeTax.doc: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.
OciEquityMethodInvestmentBeforeTax.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, before Tax

OciEquityMethodInvestmentBeforeTaxParent.doc: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to parent.

OciEquityMethodInvestmentTax.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.
OciEquityMethodInvestmentTax.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, Tax

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.
Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.
Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.label: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.
Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.label: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification Adjustment and Tax

OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.doc: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.
OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLo.label: OCI, Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax

OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCr.doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

Amount, after tax and adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to parent.

Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

Amount, before tax and adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiability.doc: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.
OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiability.label: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability

OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabilityCredit.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.
OffBalanceSheetCreditLossLiabilityCredit.label: Off-Balance-Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)

OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAssessedOn.doc: Amount of a Federal Home Loan Bank's (FHLBank) proportionate share of the costs of operating the Office of Finance.
OfficeOfFinanceAssessmentsCostAssessedOn.label: Office of Finance, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank

OilAndGasJointInterestBillingReceivables.doc: Amount of receivable from nonoperator partner in joint interest operation in oil- and gas-producing activities.
Amount of receivable from nonoperator partner in joint interest operation in oil- and gas-producing activities, classified as current.
OilAndGasJointInterestBillingReceivables.label: Oil and Gas, Joint Interest Billing, Receivable, Current

OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodA.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of oil and gas property accounted for under successful efforts method.
OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodA.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization

OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodG.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties accounted for under successful efforts method.
OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodG.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment

OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodN.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties accounted for under successful efforts method.
OilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortMethodN.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, after Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment

OilAndGasSalesPayableCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to third parties for oil and gas that has been sold but not delivered. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

OperatingCostsAndExpenses.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.
OperatingCostsAndExpenses.label: Operating Costs and Expenses

OperatingExpenses.doc: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.
OperatingExpenses.label: Operating Expenses

OperatingIncomeLoss.doc: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.
OperatingIncomeLoss.label: Operating Income (Loss)

OperatingLeaseExpense.doc: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.
OperatingLeaseExpense.label: Operating Lease, Expense

OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome.doc: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.
OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income

OperatingLeaseLiability.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.
OperatingLeaseLiability.label: Operating Lease, Liability

OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.
OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current

OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.doc: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.
OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent

OperatingLeasePayments.doc: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.
OperatingLeasePayments.label: Operating Lease, Payments

OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.doc: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.
OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAsset.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset

OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizatio.doc: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.
OperatingLeaseRightOfUseAssetAmortizatio.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Periodic Reduction

OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementDepreciati.doc: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.
OperatingLeasesIncomeStatementDepreciati.label: Depreciation, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease

OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedP.doc: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.
OriginationOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedP.label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties

OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current

OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurr.doc: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.
OtherAccruedLiabilitiesCurrentAndNoncurr.label: Other Accrued Liabilities

OtherAdditionalCapital.doc: Amount of additional paid-in capital (APIC) classified as other.
OtherAdditionalCapital.label: Other Additional Capital

OtherAdjustmentsToIncomeDiscontinuedOper.doc: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges.doc: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.
OtherAmortizationOfDeferredCharges.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges

OtherAssetImpairmentCharges.doc: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.
OtherAssetImpairmentCharges.label: Other Asset Impairment Charges

OtherAssets.doc: Amount of assets classified as other.
OtherAssets.label: Other Assets

OtherAssetsCurrent.doc: Amount of current assets classified as other.
OtherAssetsCurrent.label: Other Assets, Current

OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of other assets.
OtherAssetsFairValueDisclosure.label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure

OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent.doc: Amount of other miscellaneous assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherAssetsMiscellaneousNoncurrent.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous, Noncurrent

OtherAssetsNoncurrent.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.
OtherAssetsNoncurrent.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent

OtherBorrowings.doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.
OtherBorrowings.label: Other Borrowings

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeAvailableforsale.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-Sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, before tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeDefinedBenefitPl.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, on foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeForeignCurrencyT.label: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAmortization.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.doc: Amount, before tax and after adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.doc: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.doc: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAvailableFor.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeReclas.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) before reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeReclas.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) before Reclassifications, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTax.doc: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTax.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTaxPor.doc: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossBeforeTaxPor.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.
