OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from discontinuance of cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossCashFlowHedg.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Reclassification for Discontinuance, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount, after tax, of adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax, Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.doc: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossDerivativeEx.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.doc: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.doc: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinalization.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.
Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.doc: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.doc: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.doc: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossFinancialLia.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.doc: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossForeignCurre.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTax.doc: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossNetOfTaxPort.doc: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.doc: Amount, before tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.doc: Tax effect of plan amendments that occurred that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Plan Amendments, Tax Effect

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.doc: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossPensionAndOt.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.doc: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossReclassifica.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTax.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTax.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxPortionAt.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeLossTaxPortionAt.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent

OtherComprehensiveIncomeOtherNetOfTax.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeOtherNetOfTax.label: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.doc: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.doc: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax

OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.doc: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.
OtherComprehensiveIncomeUnrealizedHoldin.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax

OtherCostAndExpenseOperating.doc: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.
OtherCostAndExpenseOperating.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating

OtherCostOfOperatingRevenue.doc: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.
OtherCostOfOperatingRevenue.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue

OtherDepreciationAndAmortization.doc: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.
OtherDepreciationAndAmortization.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization

OtherExpenses.doc: Amount of expense classified as other.
OtherExpenses.label: Other Expenses

OtherFiniteLivedIntangibleAssetsGross.doc: Amount before accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.doc: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.
OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.label: Other General and Administrative Expense

OtherGeneralExpense.doc: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.
OtherGeneralExpense.label: Other General Expense

OtherIncome.doc: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.
OtherIncome.label: Other Income

OtherIncreaseDecreaseInEnvironmentalLiab.doc: Other increase (decrease) not attributable to current expense nor cash payments during an accounting period in estimated obligations recorded for probable future costs attributable to environmental contamination issues.

OtherIndefiniteLivedIntangibleAssets.doc: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

OtherIntangibleAssetsNet.doc: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.
OtherIntangibleAssetsNet.label: Other Intangible Assets, Net

OtherInterestAndDividendIncome.doc: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.
OtherInterestAndDividendIncome.label: Other Interest and Dividend Income

OtherInterestEarningAssets.doc: Amount of interest earning assets classified as other.

OtherInventorySupplies.doc: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other supplies used within the manufacturing or production process expected to be consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

OtherInvestmentNotReadilyMarketableFairV.doc: Value of the other investment not readily marketable determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques, that was used to record the investment for financial reporting purposes.

OtherInvestments.doc: Amount of investments classified as other.
OtherInvestments.label: Other Investments

OtherLaborRelatedExpenses.doc: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.
OtherLaborRelatedExpenses.label: Other Labor-related Expenses

OtherLiabilities.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other.
OtherLiabilities.label: Other Liabilities

OtherLiabilitiesAndDeferredRevenueNoncur.doc: Aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheet date, of noncurrent obligations and noncurrent portion of deferred revenue not separately disclosed in the balance sheet. Noncurrent liabilities are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Deferred revenue is a liability related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized, and is not expected to be recognized in the next twelve months.

OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Other Liabilities, Current

OtherLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of other liabilities.
OtherLiabilitiesFairValueDisclosure.label: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure

OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.doc: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLiabilitiesNoncurrent.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent

OtherLongTermDebt.doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.
OtherLongTermDebt.label: Other Long-Term Debt

OtherLongTermDebtCurrent.doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLongTermDebtCurrent.label: Other Long-Term Debt, Current

OtherLongTermDebtNoncurrent.doc: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
OtherLongTermDebtNoncurrent.label: Other Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent

OtherLongTermInvestments.doc: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.
OtherLongTermInvestments.label: Other Long-Term Investments

OtherMinorityInterests.doc: Carrying amount of equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in one or more of the entities consolidated into the reporting entity's financial statements other than joint ventures, limited partnerships, operating partnerships or interests held by preferred unit holders.
OtherMinorityInterests.label: Other Noncontrolling Interests

OtherNoncashExpense.doc: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.
OtherNoncashExpense.label: Other Noncash Expense

OtherNoncashIncome.doc: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.
OtherNoncashIncome.label: Other Noncash Income

OtherNoncashIncomeExpense.doc: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.
OtherNoncashIncomeExpense.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)

OtherNoninterestExpense.doc: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.
OtherNoninterestExpense.label: Other Noninterest Expense

OtherNonoperatingExpense.doc: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Expense

OtherNonoperatingGainsLosses.doc: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingGainsLosses.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)

OtherNonoperatingIncome.doc: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingIncome.label: Other Nonoperating Income

OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.doc: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.
OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)

OtherNonrecurringIncomeExpense.doc: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.
OtherNonrecurringIncomeExpense.label: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense

OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatemen.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.
OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatemen.label: Adjustment to Reconcile Net Income to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activity, Other Item

OtherOperatingIncome.doc: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.
OtherOperatingIncome.label: Other Operating Income

OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.doc: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.
OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net

OtherOwnershipInterestsValue.doc: The amount of capital contributed by other unit holders.

OtherPayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingO.doc: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.
OtherPayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingO.label: Other Payable to Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization

OtherPaymentsToAcquireBusinesses.doc: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

OtherPolicyholderFunds.doc: Amount due to policyholders for funds held that are returnable under the terms of insurance contracts, classified as other.
OtherPolicyholderFunds.label: Other Policyholder Funds

OtherPostretirementBenefitsExpenseRevers.doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.
OtherPostretirementBenefitsExpenseRevers.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash

OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayments.doc: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.
OtherPostretirementBenefitsPayments.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits

OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.
OtherPostretirementDefinedBenefitPlanLia.label: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent

OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndAdjustmen.doc: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

OtherPrepaidExpenseCurrent.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherPrepaidExpenseCurrent.label: Other Prepaid Expense, Current

OtherRealEstate.doc: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.
OtherRealEstate.label: Other Real Estate

OtherRealEstateAndForeclosedAssets.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.
OtherRealEstateAndForeclosedAssets.label: Other Real Estate, Foreclosed Assets, and Repossessed Assets

OtherReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLo.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of receivable classified as other and noncurrent.
OtherReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLo.label: Other Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent

OtherReceivables.doc: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.
OtherReceivables.label: Other Receivables

OtherReceivablesFromBrokerDealersAndClea.doc: Amount of other receivables due from broker-dealers or clearing organizations.
OtherReceivablesFromBrokerDealersAndClea.label: Other Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization

OtherReceivablesGrossCurrent.doc: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
OtherReceivablesGrossCurrent.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current

OtherReceivablesNetCurrent.doc: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
OtherReceivablesNetCurrent.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current

OtherRestrictedAssetsCurrent.doc: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.
OtherRestrictedAssetsCurrent.label: Other Restricted Assets, Current

OtherRestrictedAssetsNoncurrent.doc: Amount of noncurrent assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

OtherRevenueExpenseFromRealEstateOperati.doc: Amount of other revenue (expense) derived from real estate investments partnerships.
OtherRevenueExpenseFromRealEstateOperati.label: Other Revenue (Expense) from Real Estate Operations

OtherSecuredFinancings.doc: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpe.doc: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.
OtherSellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpe.label: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense

OtherShortTermBorrowings.doc: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
OtherShortTermBorrowings.label: Other Short-Term Borrowings

OtherShortTermInvestments.doc: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.
OtherShortTermInvestments.label: Other Short-Term Investments

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.doc: "The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given

OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.doc: "The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. ""Part noncash"" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period."
OtherSignificantNoncashTransactionValueO.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received

OtherSundryLiabilities.doc: The aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheets date, of obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements.

OtherSundryLiabilitiesNoncurrent.doc: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.
OtherSundryLiabilitiesNoncurrent.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent

OtherUnderwritingExpense.doc: Costs incurred during the period, such as those relating to general administration and policy maintenance that do not vary with and are not primarily related to the acquisition or renewal of insurance contracts.
OtherUnderwritingExpense.label: Other Underwriting Expense

PaidInKindInterest.doc: Interest paid other than in cash for example by issuing additional debt securities. As a noncash item, it is added to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.
PaidInKindInterest.label: Paid-in-Kind Interest

ParticipatingMortgageLoansParticipationL.doc: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

ParticipatingSecuritiesDistributedAndUnd.doc: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.
ParticipatingSecuritiesDistributedAndUnd.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic

PartnersCapital.doc: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.
PartnersCapital.label: Partners' Capital

PartnersCapitalAccountAcquisitions.doc: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountAcquisitions.label: Partners' Capital Account, Acquisitions

PartnersCapitalAccountContributions.doc: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).
PartnersCapitalAccountContributions.label: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions

PartnersCapitalAccountDistributions.doc: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).
PartnersCapitalAccountDistributions.label: Partners' Capital Account, Distributions

PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesAndConver.doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountExchangesAndConver.label: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions

PartnersCapitalAccountRedemptions.doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountRedemptions.label: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions

PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCapital.doc: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountReturnOfCapital.label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital

PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsPurch.doc: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.
PartnersCapitalAccountTreasuryUnitsPurch.label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedCompensat.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitBasedCompensat.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Amount

PartnersCapitalAccountUnits.doc: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnits.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAcquisitions.doc: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsAcquisitions.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConverted.doc: The number of units converted into shares of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsConverted.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Converted

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedeemed.doc: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsRedeemed.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreasury.doc: Units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsTreasury.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Treasury Units Purchased

PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsUnitbasedComp.doc: Number of units issued for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.
PartnersCapitalAccountUnitsUnitbasedComp.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-Based Payment Arrangement, Number of Units

PartnersCapitalAttributableToNoncontroll.doc: Total of all Partners' Capital (deficit) items which is directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent (noncontrolling interest, minority interest).
PartnersCapitalAttributableToNoncontroll.label: Partners' Capital Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionAttributa.doc: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.
PartnersCapitalIncludingPortionAttributa.label: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

PartnersCapitalOther.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital classified as other.
PartnersCapitalOther.label: Partners' Capital, Other

PayableInvestmentPurchase.doc: Amount of payable for purchase of investment.
PayableInvestmentPurchase.label: Payable, Investment, Purchase

PayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingOrgani.doc: Amount payable to other broker-dealer and clearing organization, including, but not limited to, security failed-to-receive, deposit received for security loaned, open transaction, and floor-brokerage payable.
PayablesToBrokerDealersAndClearingOrgani.label: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Other Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization

PayablesToCustomers.doc: Amount payable to customer by broker-dealer.
PayablesToCustomers.label: Broker-Dealer, Payable to Customer

PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.
PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset.label: Payment for Acquisition, Crypto Asset

PaymentForAdvanceForConstructionFinancin.doc: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as financing activity.
PaymentForAdvanceForConstructionFinancin.label: Payment for Advance for Construction, Financing Activity

PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.doc: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.
PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities

PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.doc: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.
PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities

PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.doc: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.
PaymentForContingentConsiderationLiabili.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities

PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts.doc: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.
PaymentOfFinancingAndStockIssuanceCosts.label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs

PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate.doc: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).
PaymentsForAdvanceToAffiliate.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate

PaymentsForAffordableHousingPrograms.doc: Amount of cash outflow for payments made by the Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks) to the Affordable Housing Program (AHP).
PaymentsForAffordableHousingPrograms.label: Payments for Affordable Housing Programs

PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOtherOtherF.doc: Amount of cash outflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability of consolidated obligations to another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).
PaymentsForBondsTransferredToOtherOtherF.label: Payments for Bonds Transferred to Other Federal Home Loan Banks

PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.
PaymentsForCapitalImprovements.label: Payments for Capital Improvements

PaymentsForConstructionInProcess.doc: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.
PaymentsForConstructionInProcess.label: Payments for Construction in Process

PaymentsForDepositsOnRealEstateAcquisiti.doc: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentFinancing.doc: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentFinancing.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities

PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentInvesting.doc: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForDerivativeInstrumentInvesting.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities

PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.doc: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.
PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.label: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities

PaymentsForFlightEquipment.doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.
PaymentsForFlightEquipment.label: Payments for Flight Equipment

PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivities.doc: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.
PaymentsForHedgeInvestingActivities.label: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities

PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTen.doc: Net cash outflow for the allowance granted to lessee and/or direct costs incurred by lessor used to prepare the leased premises for tenant's occupancy; for costs that are essential to originating the lease and would not otherwise have been incurred without the lease agreement, including but not limited to, evaluating the lessee's credit condition, guarantees, and collateral and costs incurred in negotiating, processing, and executing the lease agreement; and for any commission(s) incurred.
PaymentsForLeasingCostsCommissionsAndTen.label: Payments for Leasing Costs, Commissions, and Tenant Improvements

PaymentsForMergerRelatedCosts.doc: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

PaymentsForNuclearFuel.doc: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.
PaymentsForNuclearFuel.label: Payments for Nuclear Fuel

PaymentsForOperatingActivities.doc: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoan.doc: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.
PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoan.label: Payment for Origination and Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale

PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHel.doc: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.
PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHel.label: Payment for Origination, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale

PaymentsForOtherDeposits.doc: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

PaymentsForProceedsFromAvailableforsaleS.doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.
PaymentsForProceedsFromAvailableforsaleS.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-Sale Securities, Short-Term

PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinessesAndInte.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.
PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinessesAndInte.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates

PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
PaymentsForProceedsFromDerivativeInstrum.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBa.doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.
PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBa.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock

PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalReserveBan.doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition or sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.
PaymentsForProceedsFromFederalReserveBan.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingAct.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.
PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeFinancingAct.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingAct.doc: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.
PaymentsForProceedsFromHedgeInvestingAct.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities

PaymentsForProceedsFromHeldtomaturitySec.doc: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestments.doc: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.
PaymentsForProceedsFromInvestments.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments

PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoli.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.
PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePoli.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies

PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPartnershi.doc: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.
PaymentsForProceedsFromLimitedPartnershi.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Limited Partnership

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeases.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.
PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansAndLeases.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases

PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable.doc: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.
PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable

PaymentsForProceedsFromMortgageServicing.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

PaymentsForProceedsFromNuclearFuel.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInvestingAct.doc: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.
PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherInvestingAct.label: Payment for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activity

PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoansAndLeas.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.
PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoansAndLeas.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases

PaymentsForProceedsFromPolicyLoans.doc: Net amount paid or received by the entity associated with issuance or collection of loans made to policy holders, principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets.doc: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.
PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets

PaymentsForProceedsFromRemovalCosts.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTermInvestme.doc: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
PaymentsForProceedsFromShortTermInvestme.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-Term Investments

PaymentsForPurchaseOfInvestmentOperating.doc: Amount of cash outflow for acquisition of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, funding, origination, drawdown, and participation in investment.
PaymentsForPurchaseOfInvestmentOperating.label: Payment for Purchase, Investment, Operating Activity

PaymentsForRemovalCosts.doc: Cash outflow related to disposal costs of plants, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.
PaymentsForRemovalCosts.label: Payments for Removal Costs

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock.doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.doc: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity.label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity.doc: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfOtherEquity.label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPreferredStockAnd.doc: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfPreferredStockAnd.label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncont.doc: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemableNoncont.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest

PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferr.doc: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.
PaymentsForRepurchaseOfRedeemablePreferr.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock

PaymentsForRestructuring.doc: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgree.doc: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).
PaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgree.label: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell

PaymentsForSoftware.doc: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.
PaymentsForSoftware.label: Payments for Software

PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution.doc: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.
PaymentsOfCapitalDistribution.label: Payments of Capital Distribution

PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCosts.doc: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.
PaymentsOfDebtExtinguishmentCosts.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost

PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.doc: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.
PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs

PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffiliates.doc: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
PaymentsOfDistributionsToAffiliates.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates

PaymentsOfDividends.doc: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.
PaymentsOfDividends.label: Payments of Dividends

PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.
PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock

PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.
PaymentsOfDividendsMinorityInterest.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest

PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStockAndPref.doc: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.
PaymentsOfDividendsPreferredStockAndPref.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock

PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.doc: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.
PaymentsOfFinancingCosts.label: Payments of Financing Costs

PaymentsOfLoanCosts.doc: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.
PaymentsOfLoanCosts.label: Payments of Loan Costs

PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends.doc: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.
PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends

PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts.doc: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.
PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts.label: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs

PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareB.doc: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.
PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareB.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-Based Payment Arrangement

PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSub.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.
PaymentsToAcquireAdditionalInterestInSub.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries

PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate.doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.
PaymentsToAcquireAndDevelopRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate

PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvestingActiviti.doc: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.
PaymentsToAcquireAssetsInvestingActiviti.label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities

PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecurit.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
PaymentsToAcquireAvailableForSaleSecurit.label: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessTwoNetOfCashAcq.doc: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessTwoNetOfCashAcq.label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndInterestIn.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesAndInterestIn.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross

PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcqu.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.
PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcqu.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired

PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate.doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of property as primarily intended to generate income for its owner.
PaymentsToAcquireCommercialRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Commercial Real Estate

PaymentsToAcquireEquipmentOnLease.doc: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.
PaymentsToAcquireEquipmentOnLease.label: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease

PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.
PaymentsToAcquireEquityMethodInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments

PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.
PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Securities, FV-NI

PaymentsToAcquireFederalHomeLoanBankStoc.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.
PaymentsToAcquireFederalHomeLoanBankStoc.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock

PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveStock.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.
PaymentsToAcquireFederalReserveStock.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock

PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.
PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables.label: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables

PaymentsToAcquireFurnitureAndFixtures.doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.
PaymentsToAcquireFurnitureAndFixtures.label: Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures

PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturitySecuritie.doc: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.
PaymentsToAcquireHeldToMaturitySecuritie.label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-Maturity Securities

PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResearchAndDev.doc: The cash outflows from the purchase of net carrying value allocated to in-process research and development costs and materials acquired in a business combination.
PaymentsToAcquireInProcessResearchAndDev.label: Payments to Acquire in Process Research and Development

PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.doc: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.
PaymentsToAcquireIntangibleAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets

PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture.doc: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.
PaymentsToAcquireInterestInJointVenture.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture

PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesA.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).
PaymentsToAcquireInterestInSubsidiariesA.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates

PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.
PaymentsToAcquireInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Investments

PaymentsToAcquireLeaseReceivables.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForInvestment.doc: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.
PaymentsToAcquireLeasesHeldForInvestment.label: Payment for Acquisition, Lease, Held-for-Investment

PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies.doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.
PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities

PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartnershipInter.doc: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.
PaymentsToAcquireLimitedPartnershipInter.label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests

PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.doc: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.
PaymentsToAcquireLoansAndLeasesHeldForIn.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment

PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInvestment.doc: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.
PaymentsToAcquireLoansHeldForInvestment.label: Payment for Acquisition, Loan, Held-for-Investment

PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.
PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable

PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestments.doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.
PaymentsToAcquireLongtermInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Long-Term Investments

PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment.doc: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.
PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment.label: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment

PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities.doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.
PaymentsToAcquireMarketableSecurities.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.doc: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageBackedSecuritie.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable.doc: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageNotesReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable

PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRights.doc: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.
PaymentsToAcquireMortgageServicingRights.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)

PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.doc: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.
PaymentsToAcquireNotesReceivable.label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty.doc: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.
PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasProperty.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property

PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEqu.doc: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.
PaymentsToAcquireOilAndGasPropertyAndEqu.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment

PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments.doc: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.
PaymentsToAcquireOtherInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments

PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets.doc: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.
PaymentsToAcquireOtherProductiveAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets

PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEq.doc: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.
PaymentsToAcquireOtherPropertyPlantAndEq.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment

PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.
PaymentsToAcquireOtherRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate

PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets.doc: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.
PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets

PaymentsToAcquireProjects.doc: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.
PaymentsToAcquireProjects.label: Payments to Acquire Projects

PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.
PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipme.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment

PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate.doc: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.
PaymentsToAcquireRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate

PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRealEstate.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.
PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateAndRealEstate.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures

PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldForInvest.doc: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.
PaymentsToAcquireRealEstateHeldForInvest.label: Payment for Acquisition, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment

PaymentsToAcquireReceivables.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.
PaymentsToAcquireReceivables.label: Payments to Acquire Receivables

PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCertificatesO.doc: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.
PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedCertificatesO.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit

PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInvestments.doc: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.
PaymentsToAcquireRestrictedInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments

PaymentsToAcquireRetainedInterestInSecur.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments.doc: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
PaymentsToAcquireShortTermInvestments.label: Payments to Acquire Short-Term Investments

PaymentsToAcquireSoftware.doc: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.
PaymentsToAcquireSoftware.label: Payments to Acquire Software

PaymentsToAcquireTradingSecuritiesHeldfo.doc: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).
PaymentsToAcquireTradingSecuritiesHeldfo.label: Payment for Acquisition, Trading Security, Held-for-Investment

PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets.doc: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.
PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets.label: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets

PaymentsToDevelopSoftware.doc: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.
PaymentsToDevelopSoftware.label: Payments to Develop Software

PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProp.doc: The cash outflow for exploration and development of oil and gas properties. It includes cash payments related to development of oil and gas wells drilled at previously untested geologic structures (to determine the presence of oil or gas) and wells drilled at sites where the presence of oil or gas has already been established (to extract the oil or gas).
PaymentsToExploreAndDevelopOilAndGasProp.label: Payments to Explore and Develop Oil and Gas Properties

PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedPart.doc: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.
PaymentsToFundLongtermLoansToRelatedPart.label: Payments to Fund Long-Term Loans to Related Parties

PaymentsToFundPolicyLoans.doc: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

PaymentsToInvestInDecommissioningFund.doc: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.
PaymentsToInvestInDecommissioningFund.label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund

PaymentsToMinorityShareholders.doc: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.
PaymentsToMinorityShareholders.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests

PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSale.doc: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.
PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSale.label: Payment for Purchase, Loan, Held-for-Sale

PaymentsToPurchaseOtherLoansHeldForSale.doc: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

PaymentsToSuppliersAndEmployees.doc: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.
Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementAndPostempl.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitCont.doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitCont.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpe.doc: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitExpe.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)

PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsExp.doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsExp.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
