PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current

PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.doc: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.
Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.
PensionAndOtherPostretirementDefinedBene.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent

PensionContributions.doc: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.
PensionContributions.label: Payment for Pension Benefits

PensionExpenseReversalOfExpenseNoncash.doc: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.
PensionExpenseReversalOfExpenseNoncash.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash

PolicyLoansReceivable.doc: Carrying amount of loans made to policyholders against the cash surrender value (CSV) or other policyholder funds, and secured by the CSV, policyholder funds or the death benefit provided by the insurance contracts.

PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsIncurredNet.doc: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.
PolicyholderBenefitsAndClaimsIncurredNet.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net

PolicyholderContractDeposits.doc: Amount of liability due to policyholder for deposit held under long-duration contract issued by insurance entity.
PolicyholderContractDeposits.label: Policyholder Contract Deposit

PolicyholderDividends.doc: Amount of expense for dividends to policyholders.
PolicyholderDividends.label: Policyholder Dividends, Expense

PolicyholderDividendsPayable.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liability for dividends that are payable to the policyholders based upon the terms of the underlying insurance contracts.

PolicyholderFunds.doc: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

PostemploymentBenefitsLiabilityNoncurren.doc: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).
PostemploymentBenefitsLiabilityNoncurren.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent

PreferredStockDividendRatePerDollarAmoun.doc: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage.doc: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.
PreferredStockDividendRatePercentage.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage

PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmen.doc: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.
PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustmen.label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments

PreferredStockDividendsIncomeStatementIm.doc: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.
PreferredStockDividendsIncomeStatementIm.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact

PreferredStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.doc: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.
PreferredStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid

PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.doc: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.
PreferredStockDividendsPerShareDeclared.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared

PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.doc: Aggregate issuance value of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding.
PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital

PreferredStockIncludingAdditionalPaidInC.doc: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

PreferredStockLiquidationPreference.doc: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.
PreferredStockLiquidationPreference.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share

PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue.doc: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.
PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value

PreferredStockNoParValue.doc: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.
PreferredStockNoParValue.label: Preferred Stock, No Par Value

PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.doc: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.
PreferredStockParOrStatedValuePerShare.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share

PreferredStockRedemptionAmount.doc: The redemption (or callable) amount of currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not currently declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

PreferredStockRedemptionDiscount.doc: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.
PreferredStockRedemptionDiscount.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount

PreferredStockRedemptionPremium.doc: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.
PreferredStockRedemptionPremium.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium

PreferredStockSharesAuthorized.doc: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.
PreferredStockSharesAuthorized.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized

PreferredStockSharesIssued.doc: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.
PreferredStockSharesIssued.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued

PreferredStockSharesOutstanding.doc: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.
PreferredStockSharesOutstanding.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding

PreferredStockValue.doc: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.
PreferredStockValue.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued

PreferredStockValueOutstanding.doc: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.
PreferredStockValueOutstanding.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding

PreferredUnitsIssued.doc: The number of preferred units issued.
PreferredUnitsIssued.label: Preferred Units, Issued

PreferredUnitsOutstanding.doc: The number of preferred units outstanding.
PreferredUnitsOutstanding.label: Preferred Units, Outstanding

PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAc.doc: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.
PreferredUnitsPreferredPartnersCapitalAc.label: Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts

PremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNet.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, of all premiums and other types of receivables due from other persons or entities.
PremiumsAndOtherReceivablesNet.label: Premiums and Other Receivables, Net

PremiumsEarnedNet.doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.
PremiumsEarnedNet.label: Premiums Earned, Net

PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.
PremiumsReceivableAllowanceForDoubtfulAc.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss

PremiumsReceivableAtCarryingValue.doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.
PremiumsReceivableAtCarryingValue.label: Premiums Receivable, Net

PremiumsWrittenGross.doc: Amount of direct and assumed premiums written.
PremiumsWrittenGross.label: Premiums Written, Gross

PremiumsWrittenNet.doc: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.
PremiumsWrittenNet.label: Premiums Written, Net

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssets.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.
PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssets.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets

PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseAndOtherAssetsCurrent.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current

PrepaidExpenseCurrent.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseCurrent.label: Prepaid Expense, Current

PrepaidExpenseNoncurrent.doc: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseNoncurrent.label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent

PrepaidExpenseOtherNoncurrent.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidExpenseOtherNoncurrent.label: Prepaid Expense Other, Noncurrent

PrepaidReinsurancePremiums.doc: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.
PrepaidReinsurancePremiums.label: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums

PrepaidTaxes.doc: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
PrepaidTaxes.label: Prepaid Taxes

PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet.doc: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.
PrepaymentFeesOnAdvancesNet.label: Prepayment Fees on Advances, Net

PrincipalInvestmentGainsLosses.doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

PrincipalTransactionsRevenue.doc: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.
PrincipalTransactionsRevenue.label: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net

ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.doc: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.
ProceedsFromAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.label: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization

ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContributionInA.doc: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.
ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContributionInA.label: Proceeds from Advance for and Contribution in Aid of Construction, Financing Activity

ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.doc: The cash inflow from an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.
ProceedsFromAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.label: Proceeds from Annuities and Investment Certificates

ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFromOtherOth.doc: Amount of cash inflow from transfers and assumptions of primary liability for consolidated obligations of another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).
ProceedsFromBondsTransferredFromOtherOth.label: Proceeds from Bonds Transferred from Other Federal Home Loan Banks

ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceToAffilia.doc: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfAdvanceToAffilia.label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate

ProceedsFromCollectionOfFinanceReceivabl.doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfFinanceReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable.doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfLoansReceivable.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable

ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToR.doc: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfLongtermLoansToR.label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-Term Loans to Related Parties

ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable.doc: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfNotesReceivable.label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable

ProceedsFromCollectionOfPolicyLoans.doc: The cash inflow associated with the collection of policy loans receivable.

ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.
ProceedsFromCollectionOfRetainedInterest.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables

ProceedsFromContributedCapital.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.
ProceedsFromContributedCapital.label: Proceeds from Contributed Capital

ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruct.doc: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.
ProceedsFromContributionInAidOfConstruct.label: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction, Investing Activity

ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates.doc: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.
ProceedsFromContributionsFromAffiliates.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates

ProceedsFromContributionsFromParent.doc: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.
ProceedsFromContributionsFromParent.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent

ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.
ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt.label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt

ProceedsFromCustomers.doc: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

ProceedsFromDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeM.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.
ProceedsFromDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeM.label: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months

ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts.doc: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.
ProceedsFromDebtNetOfIssuanceCosts.label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs

ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.
ProceedsFromDecommissioningFund.label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets

ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancin.doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentFinancin.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities

ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentInvestin.doc: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.
ProceedsFromDerivativeInstrumentInvestin.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset.doc: Amount of cash inflow from disposal of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.
ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset.label: Proceeds from Disposal, Crypto Asset

ProceedsFromDispositionOfInvestmentOpera.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, repayment, principal payment, paydown, and maturity of investment.
ProceedsFromDispositionOfInvestmentOpera.label: Proceeds from Disposition of Investment, Operating Activity

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesAndIn.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOf.doc: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOf.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConso.doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInConso.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJoint.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInJoint.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture

ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsi.doc: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.
ProceedsFromDivestitureOfInterestInSubsi.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates

ProceedsFromDividendsReceived.doc: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDivide.doc: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.
ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDivide.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital

ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.doc: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.
ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.doc: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.
ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities

ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivities.doc: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.
ProceedsFromHedgeInvestingActivities.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundStateAndLocal.doc: Amount of cash received from state and local tax jurisdictions for refund of tax on income.
ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundStateAndLocal.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refund, State and Local

ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds.doc: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.
ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds

ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvesting.doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.
ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvesting.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementOperating.doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.
ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementOperating.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities

ProceedsFromInterestAndDividendsReceived.doc: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.
ProceedsFromInterestAndDividendsReceived.label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received

ProceedsFromInterestReceived.doc: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.
ProceedsFromInterestReceived.label: Proceeds from Interest Received

ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOfferin.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.
ProceedsFromIssuanceInitialPublicOfferin.label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.doc: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommercialPaper.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.doc: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferr.doc: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfConvertiblePreferr.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt.doc: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt.doc: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCap.doc: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfLongTermDebtAndCap.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt and Capital Securities, Net

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.doc: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfMediumTermNotes.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-Term Note

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfOtherLongTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-Term Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndP.doc: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPreferredStockAndP.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfRedeemableConverti.doc: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt.doc: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSecuredDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSeniorLongTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-Term Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.doc: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSharesUnderIncenti.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSubordinatedLongTe.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfSubordinatedLongTe.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-Term Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfUnsecuredDebt.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt

ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants.doc: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).
ProceedsFromIssuanceOfWarrants.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants

ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.
ProceedsFromIssuanceOrSaleOfEquity.label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity

ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestment.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.
ProceedsFromLeasesHeldForInvestment.label: Proceeds from Sale, Lease, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies.doc: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.
ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies.label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy

ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipInvestment.doc: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.
ProceedsFromLimitedPartnershipInvestment.label: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments

ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit.doc: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.
ProceedsFromLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit

ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndP.doc: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.
ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndP.label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections

ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.doc: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromLongTermLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from Long-Term Lines of Credit

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.doc: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-Maturity Securities

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.doc: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments

ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.doc: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
ProceedsFromMaturitiesPrepaymentsAndCall.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Short-Term Investments

ProceedsFromMaturitiesRepaymentsAndCalls.doc: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).
ProceedsFromMaturitiesRepaymentsAndCalls.label: Proceeds from Maturity, Repayment, and Call, Debt Security, Trading, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders.doc: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.
ProceedsFromMinorityShareholders.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests

ProceedsFromNotesPayable.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
ProceedsFromNotesPayable.label: Proceeds from Notes Payable

ProceedsFromNuclearFuel.doc: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.
ProceedsFromNuclearFuel.label: Proceeds from Nuclear Fuel

ProceedsFromOtherDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.
ProceedsFromOtherDebt.label: Proceeds from Other Debt

ProceedsFromOtherDeposits.doc: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

ProceedsFromOtherEquity.doc: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.
ProceedsFromOtherEquity.label: Proceeds from Other Equity

ProceedsFromOtherOperatingActivities.doc: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.
ProceedsFromOtherOperatingActivities.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activity

ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.
ProceedsFromOtherShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Other Short-Term Debt

ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldA.doc: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldA.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net

ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearing.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearing.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-Bearing Deposits in Banks

ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldU.doc: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldU.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase

ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermLoansForR.doc: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForLongTermLoansForR.label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-Term Loans to Related Parties

ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFinancingAct.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForOtherFinancingAct.label: Proceeds from (Payment for) Other Financing Activity

ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchas.doc: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchas.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell

ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSecurities.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.
ProceedsFromPaymentsForTradingSecurities.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-Term

ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholde.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.
ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholde.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests

ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAn.doc: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.
ProceedsFromPrincipalRepaymentsOnLoansAn.label: Proceeds from Principal Repayment, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromRealEstateAndRealEstateJoint.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoanPreviouslyCh.doc: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.
ProceedsFromRecoveriesOfLoanPreviouslyCh.label: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written off, Recovery

ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.doc: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.
ProceedsFromRelatedPartyDebt.label: Proceeds from Related Party Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivab.doc: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfAccountsReceivab.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfBankOverdrafts.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfBankOverdrafts.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.doc: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPayable.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfNotesPayable.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDeb.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDeb.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-Term Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.doc: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt

ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).
The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.
ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMat.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity.doc: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.
ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfEquity.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity

ProceedsFromRepurchaseOfRedeemablePrefer.doc: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfFinanceRe.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeld.doc: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeld.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection, Loan, Held-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansRece.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansRece.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageN.doc: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfMortgageN.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable

ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivabl.doc: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfReceivabl.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableFo.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfAvailableFo.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMatur.doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfHeldToMatur.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-Maturity Securities

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableS.doc: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfMarketableS.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvest.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfOtherInvest.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments

ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTradingSecu.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).
ProceedsFromSaleAndMaturityOfTradingSecu.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfL.doc: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.
ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfL.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-Term Investments

ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfS.doc: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionOfS.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-Term Investments

ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOf.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleMaturityAndCollectionsOf.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuri.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
ProceedsFromSaleOfAvailableForSaleSecuri.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.
ProceedsFromSaleOfEquityMethodInvestment.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.
ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Securities, FV-NI

ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalHomeLoanBankSto.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.
ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalHomeLoanBankSto.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock

ProceedsFromSaleOfFederalReserveStock.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.
ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables

ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets.doc: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.
ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets.label: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets

ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturitySecuriti.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.
ProceedsFromSaleOfHeldToMaturitySecuriti.label: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-Maturity Securities

ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInvestments.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleOfInsuranceInvestments.label: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForI.doc: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansAndLeasesHeldForI.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan and Lease, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForInvestment.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForInvestment.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale.doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Held-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.
ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable

ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvestments.doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.
ProceedsFromSaleOfLongtermInvestments.label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-Term Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuriti.doc: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).
ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageBackedSecuriti.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSa.doc: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.
ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSa.label: Proceeds from Sale, Loan, Mortgage, Held-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRight.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.
ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRight.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)

ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEq.doc: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.
ProceedsFromSaleOfOilAndGasPropertyAndEq.label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingAc.doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingAc.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestments.doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherInvestments.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeldForSale.doc: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets.doc: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherProductiveAssets.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets

ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.
ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate

ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.
ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.
ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale.label: Proceeds from Sale, Property, Held-for-Sale

ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.doc: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.
ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyPlantAndEquipm.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment

ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinves.doc: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleOfRealEstateHeldforinves.label: Proceeds from Sale, Real Estate, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInvestments.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.
ProceedsFromSaleOfRestrictedInvestments.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfSecuritiesOperatingAct.doc: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.
ProceedsFromSaleOfSecuritiesOperatingAct.label: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities

ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInvestments.doc: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.
ProceedsFromSaleOfShortTermInvestments.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-Term Investments

ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecuritiesHeldf.doc: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).
ProceedsFromSaleOfTradingSecuritiesHeldf.label: Proceeds from Sale, Debt Security, Trading, and Equity Security, FV-NI, Held-for-Investment

ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.doc: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.
ProceedsFromSaleOfTreasuryStock.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock

ProceedsFromSaleOfTrustAssetsToPayExpens.doc: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvestingActivi.doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.
ProceedsFromSalesOfAssetsInvestingActivi.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities

ProceedsFromSalesOfBusinessAffiliateAndP.doc: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.
ProceedsFromSalesOfBusinessAffiliateAndP.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets

ProceedsFromSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgre.doc: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).
ProceedsFromSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgre.label: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell

ProceedsFromSecuritizationsOfLoansHeldFo.doc: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
ProceedsFromShortTermDebt.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt

ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.doc: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).
ProceedsFromShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.label: Proceeds from Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months

ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised.doc: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.
ProceedsFromStockOptionsExercised.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised

ProceedsFromStockPlans.doc: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.
ProceedsFromStockPlans.label: Proceeds from Stock Plans

ProceedsOfOtherLoansAndLeasesHeldForInve.doc: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

ProductionTaxExpense.doc: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.
ProductionTaxExpense.label: Production Tax Expense

ProfessionalAndContractServicesExpense.doc: Professional and contract service expense includes cost reimbursements for support services related to contracted projects, outsourced management, technical and staff support.
ProfessionalAndContractServicesExpense.label: Professional and Contract Services Expense

ProfessionalFees.doc: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.
ProfessionalFees.label: Professional Fees

ProfitLoss.doc: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.
ProfitLoss.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

ProgramRightsObligationsCurrent.doc: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid within the next twelve months.

ProgramRightsObligationsNoncurrent.doc: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid after one year.

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions.doc: Amount of acquisition of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAdditions.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentAndFinanceLease.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessor.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessor.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, after Accumulated Depreciation

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.doc: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentNet.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOther.doc: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of other physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOther.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross

PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherNet.doc: Amount after depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.
PropertyPlantAndEquipmentOtherNet.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net

PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.doc: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.
Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.
PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, before Accumulated Depreciation

PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.doc: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.
PropertySubjectToOrAvailableForOperating.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Lessor Asset under Operating Lease, after Accumulated Depreciation

ProvedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortM.doc: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment, of oil and gas properties with proved reserve accounted for under successful efforts method.
ProvedOilAndGasPropertySuccessfulEffortM.label: Oil and Gas, Successful Efforts Method, Property and Equipment, Proved Property, before Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Impairment

ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.doc: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.
ProvisionForDoubtfulAccounts.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)

ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.doc: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.
ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses

ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed.doc: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.
ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)

ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses.doc: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.
ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses.label: Provision for Other Credit Losses

ProvisionForOtherLosses.doc: Amount of expense related to other loss.
ProvisionForOtherLosses.label: Provision for Other Losses

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.doc: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions

PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.doc: The component of the allowance for funds used during construction during the period based on an assumed rate of return on equity funds used in financing the construction of regulated assets.
PublicUtilitiesAllowanceForFundsUsedDuri.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Capitalized Cost of Equity

PublicUtilitiesInventory.doc: The period end amount for a type of inventory held by the utility in a schedule of inventories.
PublicUtilitiesInventory.label: Public Utilities, Inventory

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to regulated assets common to business units.
Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end amount of total net PPE.
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.
Period end amount of total gross PPE.
PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service

PublicUtilitiesPropertyPlantAndEquipment.doc: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to transmission and distribution owned by public utility.

PublicUtilitiesRequestedRateIncreaseDecr.doc: Amount of public utility's requested rate increase (decrease) with regulatory agency.
PublicUtilitiesRequestedRateIncreaseDecr.label: Public Utilities, Requested Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount

PublicUtilitiesRequestedReturnOnEquityPe.doc: Percentage of public utility's requested return on equity.
PublicUtilitiesRequestedReturnOnEquityPe.label: Public Utilities, Requested Return on Equity, Percentage

RealEstateAcquiredThroughForeclosure.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of land and buildings obtained through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement.
RealEstateAcquiredThroughForeclosure.label: Real Estate Acquired Through Foreclosure

RealEstateAcquisitionsThroughForeclosure.doc: Amount of real estate investments acquired through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

RealEstateHeldforsale.doc: Amount of investment in land and building held for sale. Excludes real estate considered inventory.
RealEstateHeldforsale.label: Real Estate, Held-for-Sale

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAccumulatedD.doc: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.
RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAccumulatedD.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCost.doc: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.
RealEstateInvestmentPropertyAtCost.label: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost

RealEstateInvestmentPropertyNet.doc: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.
RealEstateInvestmentPropertyNet.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Net

RealEstateInvestments.doc: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.
RealEstateInvestments.label: Real Estate Investments, Net

RealEstateInvestmentsJointVentures.doc: The book value of investments in real estate joint ventures including direct and indirect investments.
RealEstateInvestmentsJointVentures.label: Real Estate Investments, Joint Ventures

RealEstateInvestmentsUnconsolidatedRealE.doc: The carrying amount of investments in unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented. This includes direct and indirect investments.
RealEstateInvestmentsUnconsolidatedRealE.label: Real Estate Investments, Unconsolidated Real Estate and Other Joint Ventures

RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowance.doc: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

RealEstateTaxesAndInsurance.doc: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.
RealEstateTaxesAndInsurance.label: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance

RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentA.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentA.label: Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, before Tax

RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentD.doc: Amount, after tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating, and foreign currency transaction. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentD.label: Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, and Foreign Currency Transaction, after Tax

RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentD.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentD.label: Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax

RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeO.doc: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeO.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, after Tax

RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeO.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from realized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeO.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Investment and Derivative, Operating, Tax Expense (Benefit)

RealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndF.doc: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndF.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, after Tax

RealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndF.doc: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction on investment and derivative from change in market price, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.
RealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndF.label: Realized Gain (Loss), Investment, Derivative, and Foreign Currency Transaction Price Change, Operating, before Tax

RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.doc: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.
RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses.label: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)

ReceivableInvestmentSale.doc: Amount of receivable from sale of investment.
ReceivableInvestmentSale.label: Receivable, Investment, Sale

ReceivablesFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.
ReceivablesFairValueDisclosure.label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure

ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearing.doc: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.
ReceivablesFromBrokersDealersAndClearing.label: Receivable from Broker-Dealer and Clearing Organization

ReceivablesFromCustomers.doc: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.
ReceivablesFromCustomers.label: Receivable from Customer in Brokerage

ReceivablesNetCurrent.doc: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.
ReceivablesNetCurrent.label: Receivables, Net, Current

ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.doc: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, before Tax

ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.doc: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).
ReclassificationFromAccumulatedOtherComp.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax

ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodTax.doc: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).
ReclassificationFromAociCurrentPeriodTax.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax
