ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPermanentE.doc: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.
ReclassificationsOfTemporaryToPermanentE.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCa.doc: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCa.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCo.doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityCo.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityFa.doc: The aggregate fair value as of the reporting date of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityFa.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Fair Value

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityOt.doc: Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityOt.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Carrying Amount

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityOt.doc: Fair value of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity and classified as other equity.

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPr.doc: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPr.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPr.doc: The fair value as of the reporting date of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.
RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPr.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Fair Value

RedeemableNoncontrollingInterestEquityPr.doc: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for preferred shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

RegulatedAndUnregulatedOperatingRevenue.doc: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

RegulatedEntityOtherAssetsNoncurrent.doc: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.
RegulatedEntityOtherAssetsNoncurrent.label: Regulated Entity, Other Assets, Noncurrent

RegulatedOperatingRevenue.doc: The total amount of regulated operating revenues recognized during the period.
RegulatedOperatingRevenue.label: Regulated Operating Revenue

RegulatedOperatingRevenueElectricNonNucl.doc: The amount of regulated power revenues recognized during the period.
RegulatedOperatingRevenueElectricNonNucl.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Electric, Non-Nuclear

RegulatedOperatingRevenueGas.doc: The amount of regulated gas operating revenues recognized during the period.

RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnFederalHo.doc: Amount of fees or assessments to fund the operations of the regulator of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).
RegulatorExpensesCostAssessedOnFederalHo.label: Regulator Expenses, Cost Assessed on Federal Home Loan Bank

RegulatoryAssets.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

RegulatoryAssetsCurrent.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Such costs are capitalized if they meet both of the following criteria: a. It is probable that future revenue in an amount at least equal to the capitalized cost will result from inclusion of that cost in allowable costs for rate-making purposes. b. Based on available evidence, the future revenue will be provided to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost rather than to provide for expected levels of similar future costs. If the revenue will be provided through an automatic rate-adjustment clause, this criterion requires that the regulator's intent clearly be to permit recovery of the previously incurred cost.
RegulatoryAssetsCurrent.label: Regulatory Asset, Current

RegulatoryAssetsNoncurrent.doc: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized costs of regulated entities that are not expected to be recovered through revenue sources within one year or the normal operating cycle if longer.
RegulatoryAssetsNoncurrent.label: Regulatory Asset, Noncurrent

RegulatoryLiabilities.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory liability as itemized in a table of regulatory liabilities as of the end of the period.

RegulatoryLiabilityCurrent.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.
RegulatoryLiabilityCurrent.label: Regulatory Liability, Current

RegulatoryLiabilityNoncurrent.doc: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.
RegulatoryLiabilityNoncurrent.label: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent

ReimbursementFromLimitedPartnershipInves.doc: A payment from an investee, in which the investment basis has previously been reduced to zero. This amount reduces net cash used in operating activities.

ReinsurancePayable.doc: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.
ReinsurancePayable.label: Reinsurance Payable

ReinsuranceRecoverables.doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts including premium paid under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.
ReinsuranceRecoverables.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Including Reinsurance Premium Paid

ReinsuranceRecoverablesAllowance.doc: Amount of allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.
ReinsuranceRecoverablesAllowance.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss

ReinsuranceRecoverablesGross.doc: Amount before valuation allowance recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidAndUnpaidLo.doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, policy benefits and policy reserves. Excludes premiums paid under reinsurance contracts.
ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidAndUnpaidLo.label: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments

ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLosses.doc: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to and paid by the ceding insurer.
ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLosses.label: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid Claims and Claims Adjustments

ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLossesAllow.doc: Amount of valuation allowance for reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.
ReinsuranceRecoverablesOnPaidLossesAllow.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Allowance

RelatedPartyDepositLiabilities.doc: Amount of deposits held by the entity for a related party (entity, shareholder, employee).
RelatedPartyDepositLiabilities.label: Related Party Deposit Liabilities

RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedPar.doc: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.
RepaymentOfNotesReceivableFromRelatedPar.label: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties

RepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.doc: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.
RepaymentsOfAccountsReceivableSecuritiza.label: Repayments of Accounts Receivable Securitization

RepaymentsOfAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.doc: The cash outflow for an insurance contract under which the policy holder make a lump sum payment or a series of payments in exchange for periodic payments to the policyholder beginning immediately or at some future date.
RepaymentsOfAnnuitiesAndInvestmentCertif.label: Repayments of Annuities and Investment Certificates

RepaymentsOfAssumedDebt.doc: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.doc: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.
RepaymentsOfCommercialPaper.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper

RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt.doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.
RepaymentsOfConvertibleDebt.label: Repayments of Convertible Debt

RepaymentsOfDebt.doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.
RepaymentsOfDebt.label: Repayments of Debt

RepaymentsOfDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligatio.doc: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.
RepaymentsOfDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligatio.label: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation

RepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeM.doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.
RepaymentsOfDebtMaturingInMoreThanThreeM.label: Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months

RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.doc: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.
RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowing.label: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities

RepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond.doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument issued, secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.
RepaymentsOfFirstMortgageBond.label: Repayments of First Mortgage Bond

RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.doc: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.
RepaymentsOfLinesOfCredit.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit

RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.doc: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfLongTermDebt.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt

RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecuri.doc: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.
RepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecuri.label: Repayment of Long-Term Debt, Long-Term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security

RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit.doc: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfLongTermLinesOfCredit.label: Repayments of Long-Term Lines of Credit

RepaymentsOfLongtermLoansFromVendors.doc: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.
RepaymentsOfLongtermLoansFromVendors.label: Repayments of Long-Term Loans from Vendors

RepaymentsOfMandatoryRedeemableCapitalSe.doc: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.
RepaymentsOfMandatoryRedeemableCapitalSe.label: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities

RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.doc: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.
RepaymentsOfMediumTermNotes.label: Repayments of Medium-Term Note

RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.
RepaymentsOfNotesPayable.label: Repayments of Notes Payable

RepaymentsOfOtherDebt.doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.
RepaymentsOfOtherDebt.label: Repayments of Other Debt

RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt.doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfOtherLongTermDebt.label: Repayments of Other Long-Term Debt

RepaymentsOfOtherShortTermDebt.doc: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfOtherShortTermDebt.label: Repayments of Other Short-Term Debt

RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.doc: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.
RepaymentsOfRelatedPartyDebt.label: Repayments of Related Party Debt

RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.
RepaymentsOfSecuredDebt.label: Repayments of Secured Debt

RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.doc: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.
RepaymentsOfSeniorDebt.label: Repayments of Senior Debt

RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.doc: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
RepaymentsOfShortTermDebt.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt

RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.doc: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).
RepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInMoreT.label: Repayments of Short-Term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months

RepaymentsOfSubordinatedDebt.doc: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.
RepaymentsOfSubordinatedDebt.label: Repayments of Subordinated Debt

RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.doc: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.
RepaymentsOfUnsecuredDebt.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt

ResearchAndDevelopmentAssetAcquiredOther.doc: Amount of writeoff for research and development asset acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both.
ResearchAndDevelopmentAssetAcquiredOther.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired in Transaction Other than Business Combination or Joint Venture Formation, Writeoff

ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.doc: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.
ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense.label: Research and Development Expense

ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExcludingAc.doc: Amount of expense for research and development. Excludes cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed, writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both, and write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.
ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExcludingAc.label: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)

RestrictedCash.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.
RestrictedCash.label: Restricted Cash

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryi.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryi.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent, Current

RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.doc: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.
RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalentsNoncurre.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalent, Noncurrent

RestrictedCashAndInvestments.doc: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsCurrent.doc: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.
RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsCurrent.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current

RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsNoncurrent.doc: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.
RestrictedCashAndInvestmentsNoncurrent.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent

RestrictedCashCurrent.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.
RestrictedCashCurrent.label: Restricted Cash, Current

RestrictedCashEquivalents.doc: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.
RestrictedCashEquivalents.label: Restricted Cash Equivalent

RestrictedCashEquivalentsNoncurrent.doc: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.
RestrictedCashEquivalentsNoncurrent.label: Restricted Cash Equivalent, Noncurrent

RestrictedCashNoncurrent.doc: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.
RestrictedCashNoncurrent.label: Restricted Cash, Noncurrent

RestrictedInvestments.doc: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.
RestrictedInvestments.label: Restricted Investments

RestrictedInvestmentsCurrent.doc: This element represents the current portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.
RestrictedInvestmentsCurrent.label: Restricted Investments, Current

RestrictedInvestmentsNoncurrent.doc: This element represents the noncurrent portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.
RestrictedInvestmentsNoncurrent.label: Restricted Investments, Noncurrent

RestrictedStockExpense.doc: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.
RestrictedStockExpense.label: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense

RestrictedStockSharesIssuedNetOfSharesFo.doc: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.
RestrictedStockSharesIssuedNetOfSharesFo.label: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings

RestrictedStockValueSharesIssuedNetOfTax.doc: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.
RestrictedStockValueSharesIssuedNetOfTax.label: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings

RestructuringAndRelatedCostIncurredCost.doc: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.
RestructuringAndRelatedCostIncurredCost.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost

RestructuringCharges.doc: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
RestructuringCharges.label: Restructuring Charges

RestructuringCosts.doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
RestructuringCosts.label: Restructuring Costs

RestructuringCostsAndAssetImpairmentChar.doc: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
RestructuringCostsAndAssetImpairmentChar.label: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges

RestructuringSettlementAndImpairmentProv.doc: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.
RestructuringSettlementAndImpairmentProv.label: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions

ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletion.doc: Amount of depreciation, depletion, amortization, and accretion charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.
ResultsOfOperationsDepreciationDepletion.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization, and Accretion

ResultsOfOperationsDryHoleCosts.doc: Amount of dry hole cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

ResultsOfOperationsExpenseFromOilAndGasP.doc: Amount of cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes general corporate overhead and interest cost.

ResultsOfOperationsExplorationExpense.doc: Amount of exploration cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, geological, geophysical, and dry hole costs.

ResultsOfOperationsProductionOrLiftingCo.doc: Amount of production (lifting) cost charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, depreciation of support equipment and facility, cost of labor, material, supply, and fuel consumed and service utilized to operate oil and gas well, its equipment and facility, cost of repair and maintenance, property tax and insurance for proved property, well, and equipment and facility, and severance tax.
ResultsOfOperationsProductionOrLiftingCo.label: Oil and Gas, Result of Operation, Production Cost

RetainedEarningsAppropriated.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.
RetainedEarningsAppropriated.label: Retained Earnings, Appropriated

RetainedEarningsUnappropriated.doc: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.
RetainedEarningsUnappropriated.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated

RevenueFromCollaborativeArrangementExclu.doc: Amount of revenue from collaborative arrangement. Excludes revenue from contract with customer under Topic 606.
RevenueFromCollaborativeArrangementExclu.label: Revenue from Collaborative Arrangement, Excluding Revenue from Contract with Customer

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding.doc: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcluding.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax

RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncluding.doc: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.
RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncluding.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax

RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer.doc: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.
RevenueNotFromContractWithCustomer.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer

Revenues.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
Revenues.label: Revenues

RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.doc: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).
RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense.label: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense

RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFina.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.
RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFina.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability

RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOper.doc: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.
RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOper.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability

RoyaltyExpense.doc: Amount of expense related to royalty payments under a contractual arrangement such as payment for mineral and drilling rights and use of technology or intellectual property.
RoyaltyExpense.label: Royalty Expense

SalariesAndWages.doc: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.
SalariesAndWages.label: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold

SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainLossNet.doc: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.
SaleAndLeasebackTransactionGainLossNet.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net

SalesAndExciseTaxPayableCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).
SalesAndExciseTaxPayableCurrent.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable, Current

SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncome.doc: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.
SalesTypeLeaseInterestIncome.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLease.doc: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterA.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterA.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, after Allowance for Credit Loss

SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterA.doc: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.
SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterA.label: Sales-Type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent

SalesTypeLeaseSellingProfitLoss.doc: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.
SalesTypeLeaseSellingProfitLoss.label: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)

SecuredDebt.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.
SecuredDebt.label: Secured Debt

SecuredDebtCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, collateralized debt obligations due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer. Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.
SecuredDebtCurrent.label: Secured Debt, Current

SecuredDebtRepurchaseAgreements.doc: Carrying value, as of the balance sheet date, of securities sold under agreements to repurchase where the transferor maintains effective control over the assets, accounting for them as secured debt.
SecuredDebtRepurchaseAgreements.label: Secured Debt, Repurchase Agreements

SecuredLongTermDebt.doc: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.
SecuredLongTermDebt.label: Secured Long-Term Debt, Noncurrent

SecuritiesBorrowed.doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.
SecuritiesBorrowed.label: Securities Borrowed

SecuritiesBorrowedFairValueDisclosure.doc: Fair value portion of securities borrowed from other entities.

SecuritiesBorrowedFairValueOfCollateral.doc: Fair value of the securities received as collateral against securities borrowed.
SecuritiesBorrowedFairValueOfCollateral.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value of Collateral

SecuritiesLoaned.doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.
SecuritiesLoaned.label: Securities Loaned

SecuritiesLoanedOrSoldUnderAgreementsToR.doc: Fair value portion of securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.
SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToRese.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell

SecuritiesReceivedAsCollateral.doc: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

SecuritiesReserveDepositRequiredAndMade.doc: Securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

SecuritiesSegregatedUnderOtherRegulation.doc: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.doc: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase

SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchas.doc: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

SecuritizationFinancialAssetForWhichTran.doc: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

SecuritizedRegulatoryTransitionAssetsNon.doc: Carrying value of the regulatory asset that represents capitalized stranded costs that have been securitized (financed with debt) and are expected to be recoverable through a transition charge after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer). A transition charge is a charge approved by a regulator that allows deregulated utilities to recover investments in certain assets, such as power plants, over a transition period leading into a deregulated market.
SecuritizedRegulatoryTransitionAssetsNon.label: Securitized Regulatory Transition Assets, Noncurrent

SecurityDepositLiability.doc: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.
SecurityDepositLiability.label: Security Deposit Liability

SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAf.doc: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

SelfInsuranceReserveCurrent.doc: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).
SelfInsuranceReserveCurrent.label: Self Insurance Reserve, Current

SelfInsuranceReserveNoncurrent.doc: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).
SelfInsuranceReserveNoncurrent.label: Self Insurance Reserve, Noncurrent

SellingAndMarketingExpense.doc: The aggregate total amount of expenses directly related to the marketing or selling of products or services.
SellingAndMarketingExpense.label: Selling and Marketing Expense

SellingExpense.doc: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.
SellingExpense.label: Selling Expense

SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.doc: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.
SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense

SeniorLongTermNotes.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.
SeniorLongTermNotes.label: Senior Notes, Noncurrent

SeniorNotes.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.
SeniorNotes.label: Senior Notes

SeparateAccountAssets.doc: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.
SeparateAccountAssets.label: Separate Account Asset

SeparateAccountsLiability.doc: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.
SeparateAccountsLiability.label: Separate Account, Liability

ServicingAsset.doc: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.
ServicingAsset.label: Servicing Asset

ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValue.doc: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.
ServicingAssetAtAmortizedValue.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost

ServicingAssetAtFairValueAdditions.doc: The value of new servicing assets, subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through purchases or from transfers of financial assets.
ServicingAssetAtFairValueAdditions.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Additions

ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmount.doc: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.
ServicingAssetAtFairValueAmount.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount

ServicingLiabilityAtFairValueAmount.doc: Fair value of a liability representing servicing arrangements under which the estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

SettlementAssetsCurrent.doc: Cash received or short term receivables for unsettled money transfers, money orders, consumer payments, or business to business payments. Settlement assets include clearing and settling customers payments due to and from financial institutions and may include cash and cash equivalents.
SettlementAssetsCurrent.label: Settlement Assets, Current

SettlementLiabilitiesCurrent.doc: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.
SettlementLiabilitiesCurrent.label: Settlement Liabilities, Current

SeveranceCosts1.doc: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.
SeveranceCosts1.label: Severance Costs

ShareBasedCompensation.doc: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.
ShareBasedCompensation.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.doc: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures

ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.doc: Number of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement.
ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShare.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Shares Issued in Period

ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax.doc: Amount of excise tax on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.
ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax.label: Share Repurchase Program, Excise Tax

SharesIssued.doc: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.
SharesIssued.label: Shares, Issued

SharesIssuedPricePerShare.doc: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.
SharesIssuedPricePerShare.label: Shares Issued, Price Per Share

SharesOutstanding.doc: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.
SharesOutstanding.label: Shares, Outstanding

SharesPaidForTaxWithholdingForShareBased.doc: Number of shares used to settle grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.
SharesPaidForTaxWithholdingForShareBased.label: Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Shares Withheld for Tax Withholding Obligation

SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.doc: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.
SharesSubjectToMandatoryRedemptionSettle.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount

ShortTermBankLoansAndNotesPayable.doc: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.
ShortTermBankLoansAndNotesPayable.label: Short-Term Bank Loans and Notes Payable

ShortTermBorrowings.doc: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
ShortTermBorrowings.label: Short-Term Debt

ShortTermInvestments.doc: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.
ShortTermInvestments.label: Short-Term Investments

ShortTermNonBankLoansAndNotesPayable.doc: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

ShorttermDebtFairValue.doc: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.
ShorttermDebtFairValue.label: Short-Term Debt, Fair Value

SpentNuclearFuelObligationNoncurrent.doc: Provision for the disposal costs of spent nuclear fuel from generating stations.

SponsorFees.doc: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.
SponsorFees.label: Sponsor Fees

StockAndWarrantsIssuedDuringPeriodValueP.doc: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.
StockAndWarrantsIssuedDuringPeriodValueP.label: Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants

StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture

StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockGrantedDuringPeriodValueSharebasedC.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture

StockIssued1.doc: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.
StockIssued1.label: Stock Issued

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcquisition.doc: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesAcquisition.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.doc: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesConversionO.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDividendRei.doc: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesDividendRei.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeBen.doc: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeBen.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.doc: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesEmployeeSto.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForSe.doc: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesIssuedForSe.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues.doc: Number of new stock issued during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesNewIssues.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOther.doc: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesOther.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPeriodIncre.doc: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesPeriodIncre.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.doc: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.doc: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.doc: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesRestrictedS.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.doc: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.doc: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.doc: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesShareBasedC.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOption.doc: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesStockOption.label: Share-Based Compensation Arrangement by Share-Based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period

StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesTreasurySto.doc: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodSharesTreasurySto.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcquisitions.doc: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueAcquisitions.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.doc: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.doc: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueConversionOf.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDividendRein.doc: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueDividendRein.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeBene.doc: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeBene.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.doc: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueEmployeeStoc.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssuedForSer.doc: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueIssuedForSer.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues.doc: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueNewIssues.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueOther.doc: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueOther.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.doc: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.doc: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueRestrictedSt.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.doc: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.doc: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCo.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-Based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockDividen.doc: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockDividen.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptions.doc: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueStockOptions.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised

StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueTreasuryStoc.doc: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.
StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueTreasuryStoc.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued

StockOptionPlanExpense.doc: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.
StockOptionPlanExpense.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense

StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodShares.doc: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.
StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodShares.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares

StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodValue.doc: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.
StockRedeemedOrCalledDuringPeriodValue.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value

StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1.doc: Amount authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.
StockRepurchaseProgramAuthorizedAmount1.label: Share Repurchase Program, Authorized, Amount

StockRepurchaseProgramRemainingAuthorize.doc: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodSh.doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.
StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodSh.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares

StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodVa.doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).
StockRepurchasedAndRetiredDuringPeriodVa.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value

StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares.doc: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.
StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodShares.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares

StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue.doc: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.
StockRepurchasedDuringPeriodValue.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value

StockholdersEquity.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.
StockholdersEquity.label: Equity, Attributable to Parent

StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasuryStock.doc: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.
StockholdersEquityBeforeTreasuryStock.label: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock

StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttrib.doc: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.
StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttrib.label: Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest

StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTransaction.doc: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.
StockholdersEquityNoteSpinoffTransaction.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction

StockholdersEquityOther.doc: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.
StockholdersEquityOther.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other

StockholdersEquityOtherShares.doc: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.
StockholdersEquityOtherShares.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares

StockholdersEquityPeriodIncreaseDecrease.doc: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.
StockholdersEquityPeriodIncreaseDecrease.label: Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)

StraightLineRent.doc: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.
StraightLineRent.label: Straight Line Rent

SubordinatedDebt.doc: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.
SubordinatedDebt.label: Subordinated Debt

SupplierFinanceProgramObligation.doc: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program.

Supplies.doc: Amount of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.
Supplies.label: Prepaid Supplies

SuppliesAndPostageExpense.doc: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.
SuppliesAndPostageExpense.label: Supplies and Postage Expense

SuppliesExpense.doc: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.
SuppliesExpense.label: Supplies Expense

TangibleAssetImpairmentCharges.doc: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.
TangibleAssetImpairmentCharges.label: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges

TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes.doc: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.
TaxesExcludingIncomeAndExciseTaxes.label: Taxes, Miscellaneous

TaxesOther.doc: Amount of tax expense classified as other.
TaxesOther.label: Taxes, Other

TaxesPayableCurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).
TaxesPayableCurrent.label: Taxes Payable, Current

TaxesPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent.doc: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes.
TaxesPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent.label: Taxes Payable

TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemptionValu.doc: Value of accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value during the period.
TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemptionValu.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value

TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemptionValu.doc: Amount of decrease to net income for accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.
TemporaryEquityAccretionToRedemptionValu.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value, Adjustment

TemporaryEquityAggregateAmountOfRedempti.doc: Aggregate amount of redemption requirements for each class or type of redeemable stock classified as temporary equity for each of the five years following the latest balance sheet date. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.
TemporaryEquityAggregateAmountOfRedempti.label: Temporary Equity, Aggregate Amount of Redemption Requirement

TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributabl.doc: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountAttributabl.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Parent

TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountIncludingPo.doc: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
TemporaryEquityCarryingAmountIncludingPo.label: Temporary Equity, Including Noncontrolling Interest

TemporaryEquityForeignCurrencyTranslatio.doc: Adjustments to temporary equity resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments.
TemporaryEquityForeignCurrencyTranslatio.label: Temporary Equity, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustments

TemporaryEquityInterestInSubsidiaryEarni.doc: Subsidiary earnings portion attributable to temporary equity.

TemporaryEquityIssuePeriodIncreaseOrDecr.doc: Change in the value of each type or class of stock classified as temporary equity during the period. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.
TemporaryEquityIssuePeriodIncreaseOrDecr.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Period Increase (Decrease)

TemporaryEquityLiquidationPreference.doc: The aggregate liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
TemporaryEquityLiquidationPreference.label: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference

TemporaryEquityNetIncome.doc: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.
TemporaryEquityNetIncome.label: Temporary Equity, Net Income

TemporaryEquityOtherChanges.doc: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.
TemporaryEquityOtherChanges.label: Temporary Equity, Other Changes

TemporaryEquityParOrStatedValuePerShare.doc: Per share amount of par value or stated value of stock classified as temporary equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable.
TemporaryEquityParOrStatedValuePerShare.label: Temporary Equity, Par or Stated Value Per Share

TemporaryEquitySharesAuthorized.doc: The maximum number of securities classified as temporary equity that are permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.
TemporaryEquitySharesAuthorized.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Authorized

TemporaryEquitySharesIssued.doc: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been sold (or granted) to the entity's shareholders. Securities issued include securities outstanding and securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity.
